places.name: A.B.Café
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Situated in the trendy and style-conscious suburb of Midsommarkransen, A.B.Café is something of a trip to the 1950s era Stockholm. The café is located just a stone's throw from Konstfack University College and is a popular spot for up-and-coming designers and artists to get a relaxed cup o' joe and a fresh snack.

places.name: Prinsen
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Stockholm’s cultural elite has been dining well at Prinsen since 1897. The walls are decorated with the portraits of famous habitués. Prinsen is an excellent spot for the diner who wants to try well-prepared Swedish classic dishes in a cozy and pleasant atmosphere. Their version of Biff Rydberg is renowned, and the ser

places.name: B.A.R.
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: The Blasieholmen area has recently undergone a renaissance, with numerous exciting new establishments opening their doors. One of them is B.A.R.– a seafood grill where customers choose fish and shellfish directly from the fish tank.

places.name: Beijing8
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Smart and stylish Asian fast-food restaurants that serve top quality dumplings at very good prices. The dumplings come in a variety of taste combinations and are served with Chinese teas. Quick service in a relaxed environment. Beijing8 has one restaurant in Östermalm, one in Täby, and another one at Arlanda Airport. T

places.name: Ugglan Boule & Bar
places.label: Bar
places.note: Ugglan is not your typical bar, but more of an activity center for adults with a plethora of games and activities to choose from. Because sometimes a nice drink or beer is not enough. Sometimes you simply need arcade games, pinball, board games, foosball, dart, shuffleboard, boule or air hockey to go with that drink.

places.name: Ambar vinbar
places.label: Bar
places.note: Sherry, rum, cognac, beer and orange wine. The duo behind Ambar has a passion for amber colored liquids. Primarily a bar where you can experience carefully selected nature wines and lager beer, Ambar also has a small menu of simple Japanese snacks to complement your drinks.

places.name: Tyge & Sessil
places.label: Bar
places.note: Tyge & Sessil, celebrity chef Niklas Ekstedt's wine café, is all about the underdogs. The wine list consists of natural wines from independent small-scale producers, mainly from areas beyond the famous regions, and made from lesser-known grapes. Don't worry if you're hungry though; there’s also a small menu of simple,

places.name: Katrina Ölkafé
places.label: Bar
places.note: Located on Katarina Bangata is this snug beer pub that has succeeded in the art of being both personal and trendy. The beer comes from ultralocal microbreweries, and the snacks come in great flavors. Especially the pastrami sandwiches are much talked about. In the summer there is a small sidewalk cafe.

places.name: Savant Bar
places.label: Bar
places.note: A wine bar that leads a double life as a coffeeshop during the daytime. Either drop in for a cup of craft coffee and a tasty sandwich during lunch or wait until the afternoon when Savant opens up its bar. The focus is primarily natural wines, but you’ll also find Swedish craft beer and seasonal dishes on the menu.

places.name: Rökeriet Fjäderholmarna
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Located on Fjäderholmarna, Stockholm's closest Archipelago island, Rökeriet serves Swedish classics and seafood staples. It's a great place to escape and get a small sample taste of the archipelago, with just a 25-minute boat ride from central Stockholm.

places.name: Grand Hotel Saltsjöbaden
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Built in 1893, Grand Hotel Saltsjöbaden is an imposing landmark located in the affluent suburb of Saltsjöbaden. The hotel was built by financial tycoon K.A. Wallenberg, with inspiration from luxurious French hotels like the Hotel de Paris in Monte Carlo. Obviously, it's first and foremost a hotel. But you don't have to

places.name: Ostmakeriet
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Taste artisan cheese, made in the Stockholm Archipelago. Ostmakeriet is a small dairy on Rindö, producing cheese on milk from nearby farms and artisanal ice cream from local ingredients. Either enjoy a grilled sandwich or pie in their café or pick your selection of delicious dairy products to bring home.

places.name: Café Nizza
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Café Nizza is a local restaurant on Södermalm, with a relaxed atmosphere and a kitchen where French cooking meets Swedish flavors. Compose your own menu for a fixed price or choose any of the dishes from the à la carte menu.

places.name: V Italiano Moderno
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: V Italiano Moderno in MOOD Stockholm serves artisan pizza, pasta, and Italian small plates in the heart of the city. The menu combines classic flavors with more modern combinations, making the restaurant a popular spot for lunch, dinner, or after-work drinks.

places.name: 450 Gradi
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Treat yourself to a thick Neapolitan pizza made with typical Italian 00 flour at 450 Gradi. The seaside pizzeria is located on the Lidingö, overlooking lake Mälaren, and is a great spot for meal after a day spent exploring the island.

places.name: Adam/Albin
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Adam/Albin is the most ambitious restaurant project to date from chefs Adam Dahlberg and Albin Wessman. Located on Regeringsgatan overlooking the Royal Palace, the Royal Swedish Opera, and Parliament, the restaurant offers a fine dining experience centered around seasonal ingredients, precision, and warm hospitality. S

places.name: Agnes
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: At the cozy and quality-conscious bistro Agnes, guests quickly feel a sense of community. Come for a beer in the bar or a family dinner, or spend an evening at the restaurant. The interior decor, menu and wine list encourage flexibility when it comes to options for combining small and large plates – have a seat at a co

places.name: Ai Ramen
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: One of Stockholm's best ramen bars, Ai Ramen has served mouth-watering noodle bowls, donburi, and saké since 2015. And in that time it has become one of Södermalm's most popular hang-out spots, either to grab a lunch, dinner or an evening drink. In 2019 Ai Ramen opened a second location in the center of Stockholm on Ga

places.name: AIRA
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: In March 2020, Tommy Myllymäki opened AIRA, a fine dining restaurant on the island of Djurgården. The acclaimed chef wants the restaurant to be worth a detour – a clear hint to those who know their Guide Michelin. The kitchen focuses on seasonal Nordic ingredients, traditional cooking, and flavors from all around the w

places.name: Arc
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Arc, a restaurant and bar on the top floor of the Blique by Nobis-hotel, was named of the best rooftop bars in the world by Forbes magazine. The menu focuses on a Korean Ssäm-style sharing menu, and the terrace offers great drinks with a stunning view over northern Stockholm. For busy parents, they also offer a nanny s

places.name: Artilleriet
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Inside the massive walls surrounding the Army Museum, you'll find this hidden gem restaurant. Open for lunch and dinner, with live jazz on Tuesdays and DJs on Fridays. Don't miss the quirky cocktail menu – or the affordable cava. Dogs are welcome too!

places.name: Asplund
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Asplund takes its name from the legendary architect Gunnar Asplund who has designed the listed 1930’s building which houses the restaurant. The kitchen mixes flavors from all around the world – Asia, Europe, and the Americas – but made from fresh and locally produced ingredients. So, not only will you get the chance to

places.name: At Kungsholmen
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Neighborhood restaurant by the trio behind Petit France, inspired by New York brasseries. The Friday dinners are accompanied by live music. The restaurant also has a deli with lunches to go, sweets, and sauces.

places.name: Babas Burgers Högdalen
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Why can’t the suburbs have good restaurants with reasonable prices? That’s the question the gang behind Babas Burgers and Bites asked themselves and that led them to open up their first restaurant in Rågsved. Today Babas has relocated to Högdalen, but still serves the same hamburgers that have made them a haven for bur

places.name: Babette
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Babette is a restaurant that delivers pizza in the front room. The wine menu is constantly changing and carefully selected to match the outstanding pizza and à la carte options. Babette is located in the area of Sibirien in Vasastan.

places.name: Bar Agrikultur
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Bar Agrikultur is the new sister restaurant of popular Agrikultur. Like its older sibling, Bar Agrikultur focuses on a fixed menu of organic, seasonal and local ingredients served in an inviting and cozy setting.

places.name: Bar Central
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Bar Central is a vibrant restaurant, bistro, and bar in Södermalm, serving hearty Central European classics such as schnitzel, goulash, and apfelstrudel in a relaxed setting. Popular with both locals and visitors, it’s a natural stop for traditional comfort food with roots in Germany, Austria, and Hungary.

places.name: Barobao
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Taiwanese bao, steamed buns served with various fillings, are one of the latest trends on Stockholm’s restaurant scene. Söder is home to Barobao, an innovative, trendy and affordable Asian restaurant offering fast food with an organic sensibility. A seasonal side-dish menu complements the delicious, fluffy buns. This p

places.name: Barrels Burgers & Beer
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Hungry after a day at the The Royal Palace or Royal Armory? Why not grab a juicy burger at Barrels Burgers & Beers, just a short walk from all of Old Town's great sights. Grab a meat or veggie burger and, as you've probably guessed by the name, Barrels also has a selection of great brews to go with your food.

places.name: Bastard Burgers
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Bastard Burgers started off in the northern part of Sweden and uses 100 percent renewable energy from Swedish hydropower plants. The burgers are named after cities around the world and there is also a completely vegan menu. The branch in Vasastan was the first one to open in Stockholm, in February 2018. The restaurant'

places.name: Bergamott
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Bergamott on Kungsholmen is one of Stockholm's most beloved bistros. Traditional and simple French cuisine made from fresh and seasonal produce, with a large selection of French wines.

places.name: Berns Asiatiska
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Contemporary cuisine with inspirations from all of Asia is served in a well-preserved setting from 1863, with a gilded ceiling and magnificent chandeliers.In addition to Asian food, a cocktail menu with many signature drinks is offered and a worldwide wine list. On weekends, DJs provide music that creates a lively vibe

places.name: Bierhaus
places.label: Bar
places.note: Walk through the doors and enter a classic German beer hall, with wooden panels, communal tables, and brick walls. At the bar, you can order your favorite of the 18 German beers on tap, or ask advice from the friendly and able staff. The kitchen serves traditional German dishes like homemade sausages, sauerkraut, and p

places.name: Bistro & Grill Ruby
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Texas or Paris? The sister restaurants Bistro Ruby and Grill Ruby sit side by side in Gamla Stan, each with its own signature style reflected in the menu and décor. Choose between grilled food in US Southern down-home style, or French home cooking accompanied by wine and white tablecloths.

places.name: Bistro Bananas
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: To the highest degree possible, family-owned and trendy Bistro Bananas lives by the motto “something for everyone.” The menu seizes upon urban food culture with precision – from incredible pizzas to three-course vegan meals. The wood oven and kitschy neon colors meet in an unpretentious setting. Outdoor seating lines t

places.name: Bistro Barbro
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Barbro is a popular and cozy watering hole for Hornstull's locals. With a menu of medium-sized Asian fusion dishes, Barbro also serves refreshing drinks both in the restaurant and the downstairs bar Under Barbro.

places.name: Rival's Bistro and Bistrobar
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: At Rivals Bistro, the best seasonal ingredients are used. The popular classics are always in place as well as a "Plat du jour" as a complement to the regular menu.

places.name: Bistro Süd
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Bistro Süd is a modern bistro with a friendly atmosphere located near Mariatorget at Södermalm. The menu is inspired by the French kitchen, combined with Swedish produce and cooking tradition.

places.name: Bitza
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Bitza serves crispy Italian pizzas but with a Middle Eastern twist and ingredients typical in Palestinian, Syrian and Lebanese cooking. Tahini, hummus, shawarma, and Palestinian cheese and the zaatar spice blend to name a few.

places.name: Blå Porten
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: A classic destination for Stockholmers on a weekend walk or a visit to the museums of Djurgården island. Beautiful old interior, and relaxed bohemian garden. Tempting pastries and lunch dishes with a Mediterranean touch.

places.name: Bleck
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: The park Lilla Blecktornsparken is home to this hidden little gem, where hipster Södermalm meets families with children and couples on dates. Situated right by the park, the lush outdoor seating area becomes a glorious oasis in summer. Those who prefer to sit inside will be well-taken care of in the new, lush, glass ro

places.name: Boqueria
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Both restaurant and bar, Boqueria is the obvious meeting place in the popular shopping mall Mood for a lunch, brunch, dinner or evening drink. The busy Spanish restaurant main focus is tapas and pintxos but there’s also a selection of main courses available.

places.name: Brisket & Friends
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Have a hearty BBQ-meal in rain or shine at Brisket & Friends. The smokehouse is serious about their cuts of meats with briskets, ribs and pork belly smoked and seasoned in Texas-fashion, with tasty sides and cold beer. You can either visit the original smokehouse, out in the suburb of Årsta, or the restaurant in Vasast

places.name: Broms
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Broms, located in Östermalm, is a restaurant that delivers. The combination of a delicate menu and living room setting make Broms worth a visit. The breakfast buffet is also hard to beat with home-made marmalades, muesli, and sour-dough bread. If you prefer take-out, everything from the menu is ready to go and don't mi

places.name: Bun Meat Bun Farsta Strand
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Started by two burger enthusiasts in 2012, Bun Meat Bun originally opened in the southern Stockholm suburb of Farsta. The hamburger joint quickly proved to be a success and today you can taste their simple but meaty burgers at several locations in Stockholm, the most central being in the K25 and City Food Hall food cou

places.name: Calle P
places.label: Bar
places.note: Calle P is beautifully situated in Berzelii Park, at walking distance from the venerable Berns Sallonger, Chinateatern, and The Royal Dramatic Theatre. In other words, a great spot to enjoy a small meal and drinks before a concert or performance. During summer the open-air area is perfect to cool off with a lovely drin

places.name: Campfire
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: During the day, Campfire is a great breakfast spot in downtown Stockholm. And during the evening it morphs into a lively bar with great drinks, a great vibe AND a literal campfire over which guests can roast a marshmallow.

places.name: Cirkus Restaurang
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Located in the lush island of Djurgården in central Stockholm, the historic stage Cirkus offers a fantastic spectra of theatre, musicals, concerts and shows. Their restaurant is a creative and playful bistro inspired by the festive history of Cirkus, where they serve a variety of dishes with French, Asian and American

places.name: Coco & Carmen
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: The new owners of Coco & Carmen have really managed to put their mark on this classic lunch restaurant in Östermalm. In the evening, the à la carte is swopped out for a 9 course set menu with significant influences from their rebellious restaurant Punk Royal in Södermalm. It’s trendy, crowded, and priceworthy, even tho

places.name: Copine
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Stockholm’s Copine brings a modern take on Southern European dining to the central district of Östermalm, known for its mix of restaurants, cafés and boutiques. After a full refresh, the restaurant now features a new social food bar with views straight into the kitchen – a relaxed spot for lunch, dinner or a late eveni

places.name: Crispy Pizza Bistro
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Delicious and luxurious pizzas in Vasastan made from local produce. The flatbread might be traditional Neapolitan, but the toppings are anything but. Smoked pork belly, butternut squash, Bulgogi, honey to name a few.

places.name: Järnet
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Yet another addition to the exciting line-up of new restaurants and gastropubs in Gamla Stan. Järnet is a favorite haunt for people looking for a glass of wine and an appetizer after work, to enjoy a simple dinner, or linger through the evening with a drink in the bar. On the menu: Tapas with a Scandinavian twist and w

places.name: Delikatessen Bistro Bar
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: A cozy restaurant with a bistro feel on Södermalm. Being located inside a fire station from the early 1900s gives the restaurant a special atmosphere, the beautiful red and whitewashed floor go well with the high ceilings and the arched doorways. The French-inspired menu is carefully crafted and the staff is both frien

places.name: Den Gyldene Freden
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: In a medieval basement in the Old Town, you’ll find this classic restaurant. Owned by the Swedish Academy, which selects the Nobel Prize for literature. Legend has it that many Nobel prizes have been decided at the Academy’s regular table here. The menu offers big names in classic Swedish cooking, nowadays with interes

places.name: DoMa
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: DoMa started as an at home-restaurant. But as word of mouth spread about the delicious dinners and brunches (and the growing family needed to reclaim their living area) the concept moved into new digs at Nybrogatan 48. The homey living room-feeling is intact, and much of what you eat is grown on the family’s Ingarö-orc

places.name: Dr. Mat
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: A fresh vegetarian alternative serving 100% organic, gluten-free and lactose-free seasonal dishes. Enjoy salads, green pasta, and nutritious smoothies with influences from all over the world. Dr. Mat also offers a large selection of raw desserts and snacks.

places.name: East
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: East bar and restaurant has had its own unique personality since its inception in 1989. Asian food is served in a contemporary setting modeled on high-tech Japanese culture. The East bar often plays host to live DJ’s, and during the summer season, there is a popular outdoor dining section.

places.name: Ecobaren Centralbadet
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Ecobaren is a watering hole for people looking for a healthy and organic lunch in a relaxed atmosphere. The menu is crafted with love, natural ingredients, and raw foods, all served in a green environment. And why not combine the visit with a swim or a spa treatment at Centralbadet?

places.name: Ekstedt
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Well-known chef Niklas Ekstedt has created a kitchen in which food is prepared using the original methods over an open flame. The superb quality and artisanal excellence are familiar from Ekstedt's other restaurants, along with awareness of the sources of the ingredients and elements of Scandinavian cuisine. The ambian

places.name: Etoile
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Etoile means “star” in French, and the restaurant was indeed rewarded with a Michelin star in February 2020. Etoile offers a playful set menu of 20 courses. Open for dinner Tuesday-Saturday.

places.name: Falafelbaren
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Take your meal to go if you are not lucky enough to get a seat in this hole-in-the-wall-sized restaurant. Freshly fried falafel is, of course, the hero on the menu but you can also choose from traditional dishes like börek. The food is made to order and definitely worth the wait.

places.name: Farang
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: One of the best Asian restaurants in Stockholm can be found on Norrmalm. Farang will envelop you in its very own world on the ground floor of the old factory space, Stockholms Elektricitetsverk (Stockholm Electric Works). The industrial feel remains, but now features simultaneously rustic and modern design elements wit

places.name: Flippin' Burgers
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Before opening Flippin' Burgers, the owner traveled around the US in search of inspiration on how to make the perfect burger. After returning home, he crowdfunded the restaurant and got started on his burger-quest. Now, many connoisseurs agree that he excelled. Soon Flippin' turned out to be a success and to better acc

places.name: Folii
places.label: Bar
places.note: The wine bar Folii is the brainchild of sommeliers Béatrice Becher and Jonas Sandberg. Combining their many years of experience and expertise, the bar offers an ever-changing wine list depending on their new discoveries, and a menu to compliment their current favorites.

places.name: Frantzén
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: In 2016, renowned chef Björn Frantzén moved his luxurious restaurant from Gamla Stan to Klara Norra Kyrkogata in downtown Stockholm for a new and unique dining experience. The restaurant is located in a renovated 19th-century townhouse, where 23 guests change rooms and floors as they work their way through the fixed fi

places.name: Gastrotek Zink
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: The classic restaurant Zink Grill has left Norrmalm for Östermalm and become Gastrotek Zink. Regulars don’t have to worry though: The head chef is the same and the grill still plays the leading role. Stockholmers come here for a quick breakfast before work, a bustling dinner, or one last drink at – you guessed it – the

places.name: Giro
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Giro is the result of a genuine collaboration based on like-minded values between Nobis and one of the world's oldest pizzerias Da Michele. With inspiration from classic pizzerias in Naples and ingredients selected with extra care, Giro creates pizzas to love.

places.name: Goma
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Goma is Sweden's first Asian gastropub. It opened in October 2020, just around the corner from sister restaurant Miss Voon. Come for lunch (to stay or to go), an afternoon meeting, dinner, or a late drink. No reservations drop-in only.

places.name: Gondolen
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Having been closed for renovation for several years Gondolen made a comeback, under new management, in October 2023. The new menu fuses exclusive and elegant ingredients with beloved comfort food like ratatouille and fish gratin. The view overlooking Gamla Stan, Djurgården, and the waters of Saltsjön, is still one of t

places.name: Göteborg
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Seasonal and fresh food served in a great setting at the waterfront of Hammarby Sjöstad. The menu at Göteborg (the restaurant, that is) is in constant flux, but with an affinity for delicious seafood. And just like the town of Göteborg, you can reach it either by boat or tram.

places.name: Greasy Spoon
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: This is a great brunch spot from breakfast to dinner, offering a menu of British classics with a modern twist. At Greasy Spoon you can have your eggs benedict any time of the day, together with the sound of the jukebox or even a Bloody Mary.There are four Greasy Spoon venues: at Tjärhovsgatan 19 and Södermannagatan 53

places.name: Grill
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: A vast array of ingredients and a huge number of barbecue techniques, with inspiration from five continents. The interior is playful and imaginative, to say the least, with nine different styles, spanning from hunting lodge to Versailles.

places.name: Grodan
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Originally named La Grenouille, Grodan bowed under the pressure of its regulars who had a hard time pronouncing its French name. Their influence didn’t stop there, which has made Grodans menu and interiors one of the most beloved and well-known in the Stockholm restaurant scene since Grodan opened its doors for the fir

places.name: Restaurang Häktet
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: This old prison is a place to escape to, rather than from. Whether you're looking for a nice meal or to party like a prisoner, with three bars and an interesting Stockholm crowd, this is the place for a night out. Häktet is also one of few bars on Södermalm that closes at 3 am.

places.name: Hallwylska
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Hallwylska restaurant and bar may be one of the most beautiful inner courtyards in Stockholm. This is the place for dinner and drinks or just some refreshments after a visit to the Hallwyl Museum – or even lunch with a palace view. Open during summer months only.

places.name: Hermans
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Using organic ingredients, over 60 spices and inspiration from cuisines all over the world, Hermans sets out to prove that "vegan" doesn’t mean "boring". The buffet is completely vegan. In addition, the restaurant boasts a panoramic view of the entire inlet to Stockholm. In the summer there’s plenty of room in the shad

places.name: Hillenberg
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: South European classics meet Swedish flavors and interior design at Hillenberg. The restaurant, located on Östermalm, is run by celebrity chef Niklas Ekstedt and has a close partnership with Ekstedt's wine café Tyge & Sessil. In other words: great food and great wine!

places.name: Hjärtat på Torget
places.label: Bar
places.note: Torget is the obvious meeting place for Stockholm’s gays. Many people stop here during the night because of its central location in Gamla Stan. At Torget, you can also get updates on the latest and tips on what there is to do in Stockholm.

places.name: Hornhuset
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Hornhuset is a hip, trendy and popular venue with restaurants, bars and clubs on three floors, plus a rooftop patio that is open in summer. Each floor has its own theme and the atmosphere is usually exuberant in the popular premises in Hornstull, Södermalm. On weekends, be smart and arrive early to beat the lines.

places.name: Husmor Lisa
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: At Husmor Lisa they want you to feel at home. The restaurant calls its menu Fine Home Dining - classic Swedish everyday dishes but with a luxurious twist, enjoyed in a setting that feels homey and cozy. Situated on the picturesque island of Resarö in the northern archipelago, Husmor Lisa uses seasonal ingredients eithe

places.name: Ichi
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: The sister restaurant of Barabao, Ichi, is a Japanese fusion restaurant that delights guests with a fixed menu with smaller dishes. The award-winning restaurant has become quite a hotspot for the residents of Södermalm so a booking well in advance is recommended.

places.name: Il Tempo
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Il Tempo is one of Södermalm's most popular Italian restaurants, serving staples of the Apennine Peninsula like pizza, pasta, and classic chicken and fish dishes. And of course a large selection of wines and Italian spirits.

places.name: Josefina
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: A popular and well-attended summer club and restaurant on the green island of Djurgården, a stone's throw from the Nordic Museum. Josefina offers an exotic environment with palm trees, waterfront views, and a large sun deck. Here, you can enjoy a drink, have dinner or dance to the latest house music. Open May-September

places.name: K25
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: A modern, urban food court a touch above the ordinary. You will find high-quality, inexpensive dishes from all over the world. A popular lunch place among office workers in central Stockholm. Sit down at one of the long tables and get to know the locals.

places.name: Kalf & Hansen
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: On Mariatorget Square on Södermalm, you’ll find lunch restaurant Kalf & Hansen, run by a father and son team. The menu consists of a fine offering of Nordic, organic fast food, centered on beef, fish, and vegetarian quenelles served with salad and tasty sauces. The interior design is simple and tasteful, just like the

places.name: Karamellan
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Karamellan has been serving classic Swedish cuisine and fika since the 19th century. With its proximity to one of Stockholms three UNESCO World Heritage Sites, it’s the perfect place to cap off your visit to Drottningholm Palace and treat yourself to a delicious meal.

places.name: KB, Konstnärsbaren
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: The distinguished Konstnärsbaren ("Artists' bar") prepares Swedish traditional cuisine and delicacies with love and care. Beautiful bar, separate from the main restaurant, with murals. A classic meeting point.

places.name: K-Märkt
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: K-märkt is located inside the culturally historic Garnisonen building. It has its own bakery and is run by celebrity pastry chef Daniel Roos, beverage expert Jens Dolk and chef Hanna Normark. The restaurant aims to unify fine dining and large-scale production as a single concept. The menu changes constantly and is guid

places.name: Kommendören
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Relaxed, personal and cozy. Kommendören on Östermalm is a pleasant neighborhood restaurant with a bar that is equally lovely. The menu is based on the staff’s personal favorites and varies from month to month with flavors from the US, France, and Sweden. White tile and wooden interiors provide a sense of harmony withou

places.name: Lådan
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Housed in a raw - almost industrial - setting with cement floors and plywood walls, Lådan (or The Box) is sister joint to the super popular Flippin' Burgers. Lådan is a large beer hall and slider restaurant with the same love for simple street food of the highest quality as its older sibling.

places.name: Landet
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Classic, seasonal traditional dishes meet French cuisine and flirt with the rest of the world. Landet is a well-known spot at Telefonplan, 10 minutes from City. Popular, unpretentious, industrial and welcoming, this is a place to which people regularly return each weekend to eat, hang out in the bar or dance the night

places.name: Långa Raden – Hotel Skeppsholmen
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: The idyllic island of Skeppsholmen is situated just a stone's throw from the hustle and bustle of the city, but still in the heart of downtown. Classic Hotell Skeppsholmen and its restaurant Långa Raden are situated in a park-like area at the water's edge, in a setting that has been preserved since the 17th century. Th

places.name: Långbro Värdshus
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Långbro Värdshus offers a quiet and relaxed setting for a delicious lunch, dinner or brunch away from Stockholm’s busy city center. The modern inn is located on the southwestern outskirts of town and also gives you a chance to explore typical Swedish 1960’s architecture in the surrounding suburb of Fruängen.

places.name: Långholmens Wärdshus
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: On leafy Långholmen, Långholmen's Wärdhus is housed in an old country estate from the 17th century. In the historical environment lie a restaurant, a hotel, a conference and a museum.In the restaurant, you can eat traditional Swedish food prepared with local ingredients for lunch and dinner. On weekends, brunch is also

places.name: L'Avventura
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: L'Avventura's is located on the premises of a former movie theater which is hinted at both in its name (having a namesake in Michelangelo Antonioni's 1961 masterpiece) and in its stylish and grandiose main dining room. The menu consists of classic dishes covering the whole Apennine peninsula. The restaurant's ambition

places.name: Le Rouge
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Brunnsgränd 2-4 is an address that has been associated with food for centuries. It's gone from being a fish market hall during the Middle Ages to a potato storage house in the 18th century and wine house in the 19th century. Today it's the Moulin Rouge-inspired restaurant Le Rouge. The menu is both Swedish and internat

places.name: Lilla Ego
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Lilla Ego is a neighborhood restaurant in Vasastan, where the love for Swedish food shines through in every dish. The two owners are award-winning chefs who serve luxurious food, at a very reasonable price and in a cozy and informal environment.

places.name: Lily's Burger
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Lily’s Burger doesn’t just serve you great hamburgers, shakes, and fries. Started by Swedish actors Mahmut Suvakci and Joel Kinnaman, the burger joint lets you enjoy a plate of Americana in a cozy 50’s dinner. Stalls with leather sofas, neon lights and of course a jukebox or two.

places.name: Lisa Elmqvist
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Since 1926, Lisa Elmqvist has been a restaurant associated with first-class fish and seafood. Located in the beautiful Östermalmshallen food hall, the restaurant supplies patrons with well-prepared food made from delicacies from the sea. There is also a wine bar and a deli shop.

places.name: Loopen
places.label: Bar
places.note: A relaxed atmosphere and West Indies feel attracts both landlubbers and seafarers to this boat club. Take a seat in a lounge chair under one of the artificial palms and watch the boats dock. The restaurant serves light snacks as well as hearty meals. Lots of fish and shellfish but also American-style meat dishes. A Car

places.name: Lux Dag för Dag
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: A couple of years ago, reputed gourmet restaurant Lux on the island of Lilla Essingen re-opened with a more simplistic and affordable concept. Close to nature, Scandinavian flavors and local produce is however still the main focus. Cozy atmosphere and secluded location with Lake Mälaren nearby.

places.name: Luzette
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: In the middle of the bustling central station, you will find this light and spacious oasis, with a beautiful décor and pleasant atmosphere. Luzette serves brasserie-style cuisine of high class, but there are also plenty of seats if you just fancy a coffee. There is also a deli with ready meals, bread, and sweets.

places.name: Lydmar
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Lydmar’s homey living room, with its unfailing sense of style, has won the hearts of Stockholmers. A broad spectrum of dishes is served in the restaurant, extending over all international borders, as if you were in the home of a good friend.

places.name: Magnolia
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Magnolia is situated just a stone’s throw from Monteliusvägen, the popular viewpoint on Södermalm. Their specialty is bao, a Taiwanese bun steamed and stuffed with various delicious fillings. Pick one on offer from the menu, or compose one yourself. There is also a selection of dishes from East Asia with typical Japane

places.name: Mälarpaviljongen
places.label: Bar
places.note: A verdant oasis with a restaurant, bar, and alfresco section, located on the pier, waterfront and a barge at Norr Mälarstrand with a stunning view of the waters of Riddarfjärden. Atmospheric, cozy local restaurant and high-spirited bar with great music. Open during the summer season only.

places.name: Mäster Anders
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Pleasant local eatery on Kungsholmen that dates from 1905 and has preserved the turn-of-the-century style in features including the beautiful tiled floor. The menu is Swedish and French-inspired and dominated by beautifully prepared meat dishes.

places.name: Matateljén
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Beloved restaurant Matateljén has settled into Stockholm's up and coming area Slakthusområdet, where its creative approach to seasonal cooking continues to evolve. The vibrant space is centered around an open kitchen designed as several individual stations. The kitchen offers a four-course set menu with either seafood

places.name: Matbaren
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Matthias Dahlgren's Matbaren likes to keep it relaxed and informal. This bistro, housed in Grand Hôtel on Blasienholmen, uses the very best of fresh seasonal produce, to create a vibrant menu of medium-sized dishes and well-paired wine and beverages. Matbaren serves lunch Monday through Friday and dinner Monday through

places.name: Meatballs for the People
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Meatballs for the People is a restaurant, bar, and deli in Stockholm's vibrant Södermalm area, dedicated to the Swedish meatball. The menu features more than a dozen variations, from the classic with cream sauce to elk, wild boar, salmon, and vegetarian options. A lively, rustic setting where you can sit down for a mea

places.name: Meno Male
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Not only are Meno Males delicious Neapolitan pizzas made from typical tipo flour and traditional Italian ingredients like fior di late, prosciutto cotto and Portobello mushroom. The restaurant’s pizza oven itself was made by craftsmen in Napoli and later shipped to Sweden, to make sure every plate keeps the highest cri

places.name: Misshumasshu
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Misshumasshu is a lively restaurant, bar, and brasserie that now fills an entire neo-renaissance arcadein central Stockholm. Historic architectural details meet a modern dining space centered around a social bar. The menu draws inspiration from East Asia with clear Japanese influences, offering shareable dishes alongsi

places.name: Nalen Restaurang
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Located in the renowned Nalen, a classic nightclub with roots dating back to the swingin' 20’s, Nalen Restaurang is a place to catch a delicious meal before the evening's concert. Fresh and seasonal ingredients on a classic Swedish menu that strives to serve you sustainable food. They also serve a Jazzbrunch on Saturda

places.name: Nook
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Nook serves its well-known mix of Nordic flavors and Asian influences in Stockholm's vibrant Södermalm district. The kitchen works with seasonal ingredients and keeps a thoughtful, sustainable approach at the center of what they do. The set three-course menus can be paired with a range of small snacks, and larger group

places.name: Nya Carnegiebryggeriet
places.label: Bar
places.note: A modern artisan brewery and restaurant in a former lightbulb factory called Lumahuset, in Hammarby Sjöstad. From a collaboration between Brooklyn Brewery and Carlsberg come classical brews with a modern twist. Enjoy the gorgeous space, have a bite to eat, and try the house brews. The outdoor patio opens during summer.

places.name: Nybrogatan 38
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Breakfast, lunch, dinner, or drinks - Nybrogatan 38 is open from morning till late. The menu combines Scandinavian classics with Mediterranean influences, served in a relaxed and lively setting. A social spot in Stockholm's Östermalm district where food, drinks, and music come together throughout the day.

places.name: Nytorget 6
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Nytorget 6, which is in the trendy SoFo section of Södermalm, offers classic Swedish food with influences from Southern Europe. Here you can eat well morning, noon and night. Start the day with a croissant or a bowl of porridge, or finish off the evening with a planked steak or lobster omelet. The atmosphere is cozy wi

places.name: Nytorget Urban Deli
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Urban Deli Nytorget is located in the heart of Sofo on Södermalm. Here you'll find everything from breakfast and lunch to coffee breaks or after-work drinks. In the deli and shop, you'll find not only cheese and charcuterie, but also ready-made dinner kits, single-portion meals, and freshly baked bagels. During summer,

places.name: Omaka
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Omaka is a brewery, restaurant, bar, and beer garden created by Sweden's youngest brewmaster Hedda Spendrup. The restaurant has an open kitchen concept, where head chef Christian Siberg has composed a menu with modern dishes to pair with every beer brewed in the building. The spacious bar has large windows overlooking

places.name: Operakällaren
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: A classic. Sweden's most famous dining room, in the same building as the Royal Swedish Opera. A magnificent setting, with views of the water across the Royal Palace from the terrace bar. Dine on first-class international delicacies, presented with bold, contemporary flair. The legendary Nobis wine cellar is a wine love

places.name: Operakällarens bakficka
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Classic mini-bistro and food bar with well-made traditional Swedish dishes. Part of the Operakällaren’s food palace. Very popular for lunch. No reservations, so come early or late.

places.name: Paradiso
places.label: Bar
places.note: Cozy bar with a menu of light vegetarian dishes on their menu. The bar, located close to Mariatorget, also has one of the finest collections of rum in town.

places.name: Pelikan
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Pelikan provides a glimpse of Stockholm in the old days when there was a beer café on every corner. Classic Swedish home fare is served in a rustic beer hall with high ceilings, where the atmosphere is relaxed, the food is affordable and the crowd is a mix of people. Pelikan is a long-time favorite of many in the city’

places.name: Phil's
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: The first Phil's Burger opened up in 2014, and since then new joints have popped up all over the city – Danderyd, Gärdet, and Fältöversten to name a few locations. Phil's hamburgers are made from carefully selected ingredients, with buns from their own bakery, and they offer both vegetarian and gluten-free options.

places.name: Pocket by Pontus
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Simplicity and style define the concept at this French-Swedish bistro, located opposite Mall of Scandinavia. Pocket by Pontus offers fast quality lunch and take away, and is also open during events at Friends Arena.

places.name: Portal
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Award-winning chef Klas Lindberg offers a food experience with loads of heart and culinary joy – Portal is a familiar and casual restaurant with high ambitions. The menu combines French and Nordic cuisines and features ingredients from all over Sweden. The pleasantly unpretentious light wood decor creates a cozy atmosp

places.name: Proviant
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: A little big-city restaurant or a big local eatery? Food is prepared with curiosity along the theme: classic dishes, modern tastes.

places.name: Råkoko
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Råkoko, located at the beautiful 17th Åkeshofs Castle, lies just a short walk from Åkeshov metro station. The name is a play on words underscoring the manor's late baroque-interior, as well as the restaurant's, focus on healthy and fresh produce. Guests are treated to plant-based food – with fish and meat as an added o

places.name: Reggev Hummus
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Reggev Hummus on Ringvägen is all about the delicious dip made from chickpeas and beans. Although having a few meat dishes, a large part of the Middle Eastern menu can be enjoyed by vegetarians and vegans alike.

places.name: Restaurang AG
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: AG is the chemical symbol for silver and the name stems from the fact that this trendy and popular industrial-chic restaurant on Kungsholmen is set in an old silver factory. Despite its somewhat off-beat location and the fierce competition, AG immediately became a meeting place that attracted ’everyone’ and a major top

places.name: Restaurang Hantverket
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: “Hantverk” literally means “craft” in Swedish, and Restaurang Hantverket emphasizes just that; the delicate craft of cooking. The best seasonal ingredients are chosen to highlight authentic Swedish and rustic flavors and the interior concept strives to be just as cozy and homey.

places.name: The Restaurant  - Fotografiska
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Combine a visit to one of Stockholm's most popular museums, Fotografiska, with a dinner at its award-winning restaurant. The vegetarian menu at Restaurangen puts in-season and locally produced vegetables front-row-and-center with added flavors from the animal kingdom. All dishes on the menu are available without meat o

places.name: Rolfs Kök
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Rolfs Kök has become a modern restaurant classic. Its founder, Rolf, wanted an open kitchen in order to be in contact with the guests. He was one of the early people to bring in well-known Swedish architects to create the right environment. Jonas Bohlin and Thomas Sandell were given nearly a free hand, and the result w

places.name: Rost
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Rost is a charming place reminiscent of restaurants in The Village. Go here for the warm atmosphere, the organic food, tasty pizzas and live music on stage – or to fix up your motorcycle!

places.name: Sally Voltaire & Systrar
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Calling themselves a food-spa, Voltaire serves modern vegetarian food complemented by fish and seafood. The restaurant is located in the Åhléns City department store and is a bright and relaxed oasis for busy shoppers. There is also a store selling everything from organic tea to soap and clever tools for the kitchen.

places.name: Scandwich
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: The people at Scandwich are serious about their bread. The restaurant serves up finger-licking-good sandwiches, both for meat-eaters and vegetarians, spilling over with fresh ingredients and delicious dressings.

places.name: Smak
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: The flavors are the stars here! The inventive restaurant concept is based on having guests select three, five or seven flavors, which correspond to appetizers of the same size. The food comes from all corners of the globe. The drinks work the same way – small glasses customized to each dish. Well-known DJ’s often take

places.name: Snack Bar
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Snack bar is a fast food restaurant created by renowned fine-dining chefs. Focus lies on kebab the French way, with fewer ingredients than regular döner and sauces based on mayonnaise, and with the Baguette Américain as their crown jewel.

places.name: Sollidens restaurang
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: This iconic restaurant at the open-air museum Skansen has a breathtaking panoramic view of Stockholm. For the 2026 season, renowned restaurant group Stureplansgruppen has been entrusted as the new restaurateur and creative partner of Restaurang Solliden.

places.name: Soyokaze
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Batjargal Ochirbat’s Soyokaze has been the talk of the town since its opening in late 2016. The small 12 seat restaurant serves its exclusive sushi Omakase-style, roughly translated “I trust you”. In other words, the menu is up to the chef who makes and serves the exclusive sushi one at a time.

places.name: Spanjorskan
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Spanjorskan is a lively Spanish restaurant in Stockholm, inspired by regional cooking from across Spain. The menu centers on shared plates, seafood, and classic flavors, suited for both casual drinks and tapas-style dinners. A social spot where food and conversation naturally come together.

places.name: Stadshuskällaren
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Everyone who doesn’t have the advantage of being invited to the Nobel ceremonies can still sample the food at Stadshuskällaren, which offers all of the Nobel menus that have been served since 1901. The restaurant is located in Stockholm City Hall (where the annual Nobel banquet is served in the Blue Hall). The cellar v

places.name: Stallmästaregården
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: A stone's throw from the city in Haga Park on the shore of Brunnsviken lake is the eighteenth-century Stallmästaregården inn. Classic Swedish home fare is served here in a Gustavian setting.

places.name: Strandbryggan
places.label: Bar
places.note: Beautifully situated bistro at the Djurgården Bridge with on-the-water service. The popular, well-stocked bar focuses on rosé wines and champagne. Strandbryggan serves shellfish, fish, salads, and regular fare in a setting that is a little more elegant than average. They also have boats for rent.

places.name: Strandvägen 1
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Strandvägen 1 is an international all day-bistro located in the upscale neighborhood of Östermalm. Just next door to the Royal Dramatic Theatre and with a lovely view overlooking the docks at Nybrokajen, the restaurant and bar is a popular hangout on a warm summer day.

places.name: Sturehof
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Classic brasserie and social stage at Stureplan in the center of Stockholm’s entertainment precinct. Swedish cuisine with international influences. Several bars. In summer the alfresco section is the place to see and be seen.

places.name: Surfers
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Colorful, spicy, and good-natured – that’s the vibe at Surfers. It may be surprising from the name, but Surfers is home to an excellent Chinese restaurant. Inspired by the 23 flavors of Sichuan cuisine and 56 cooking methods, the menu is based on some fifteen small plates, and you get to choose which favorites to share

places.name: Humlan
places.label: Bar
places.note: Humlan is a summer bar and restaurant located on the corner of Humlegården Park, near Stureplan. The menu features a variety of Italian bread dishes and refreshing drinks. This version of Humlan is run by Oliver Ingrosso, who usually operates the restaurant Olli.

places.name: Sushi Sho
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: At first glance Sushi Sho looks like an ordinary sushi place, but it is, in fact, a Michelin starred restaurant. Here, high-quality sushi is served Tokyo-style, and the fish is selected with regard to sustainability and the environment. All guests are served a menu consisting of about 15 dishes - prepared and served fr

places.name: Svartengrens
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: At Svartengrens they love meat, but they're not in love with the meat industry. That's why you'll only get served locally produced cuts from the Stockholm archipelago that have been smoked, brined, and hung by Svartengren's team of chefs. Served with a side of seasonal vegetables, of course. The menu changes often, som

places.name: Tak
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Tak ("roof" in Swedish) is located, quite literally, in the heart of the city just a short walk from Sergels Torg. It's a restaurant, a raw bar, and a rooftop bar all rolled up into one. The menu mixes Japanese techniques and Swedish ingredients with a breathtaking view of central Stockholm.

places.name: Tako
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Elegant Japanese and Korean-cuisine that brings out the best flavors of Asia on to one plate. Spacious Tako on Östermalm in Stockholm has both a sushi bar and kitchen and an Asian grill serving spicy tempura and skewers.

places.name: Teatergrillen
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Teatergrillen is a playground for Stockholm’s media and cultural celebrities. You’ll dine well here in a traditional setting. The interior is largely unchanged since 1968, making this one of Sweden’s best-preserved restaurants. Red velvet and theater props dominate the decor, thanks to the nearby Dramaten theater.

places.name: Teatern
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Teatern at Ringen Centrum near Skanstull combines the concepts of fine cuisine and popular food-court dining. Some of Sweden’s best-known restaurateurs share the 250 seats in the dining area – such as Adam Dahlberg & Albin Wessman, Sayan Isaksson, and Nobel pastry chef Daniel Roos. At Teatern, you can taste world-class

places.name: Tegelbacken
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Markus Aujalay's and Erika Michael's bright and welcoming Tegelbacken wants you to try everything. Fresh and unpretentious medium-sized dishes are served to help guests to have the appetite to try out just one more dish. And one more. And maybe one more.

places.name: Tennstopet
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Restaurants come and go, but Tennstopet has endured for decades. Have a taste of Swedish home fare in a neighborhood restaurant with Vasastan charm. Not only does Tennstopet change its menu according to the season, but they also have special dishes that return each year like black soup and crow (yes, crow).

places.name: Terrassen Grand Hôtel
places.label: Bar
places.note: Sit outside on the terrace of Grand Hôtel and savor Mediterranean-inspired dishes or sip a glass of wine, while enjoying the view of the Royal Palace and the waterfront. Drop-in seats only.

places.name: The Border
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: The aptly named The Border is located at the southern edge of Södermalm, bordering to the southern suburbs of Stockholm. The menu pits American hamburgers against Mexican burritos. As the first burger joint in Stockholm, The Border also offers patties made from Wagyu-beef.

places.name: The Fishery
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: The Fishery is, as the name implies, all about fish, shellfish and plants from the depths. Simple yet delicious fish burgers, spicy salmon and fish taco with the freshest ingredients form our waterways.

places.name: The Italian Cousins
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Started by cousins Davide and Enrico, The Italian Cousins is a great place for genuine pizza made of fresh produce from smaller Italian and Swedish farms and producers. Come in for a quick snack, lunch or dinner. They currently have three spots; a pizzeria in Vasastan, a pizzeria and bar in Normalm and a pizzeria and s

places.name: The Strand
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: The Strand is a Swedish brasserie serving classic flavors in a unique and relaxed venue. Enjoy everything from breakfast, brunch, and lunch to afternoon tea or fun after work-drinks with the lovely view of Nybrokajen.

places.name: The Veranda
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Cosmopolitan, elegant and classic. The Grand Hotel veranda is an international rendezvous that serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner 365 days a year. The Veranda is also one of the few restaurants in Stockholm that offer a genuine Swedish smörgåsbord for most of the year. A beautiful view over the water and Gamla Stan is

places.name: Torpedverkstan
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: The archipelago ambiance in the middle of the city – Torpedverkstan Restaurang & Bar is located on Skeppsholmen, only a ten-minute walk from the park Kungsträdgården. Industrial romance meets sea salt in a former torpedo factory right on the quay line with a lovely view of the boats, Nybroviken, Strandvägen, and Djurgå

places.name: Totemo Ramen
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: The ramen trend has finally arrived in Stockholm. At Totemo you’ll get a hearty bowl of ramen served in laid-back surroundings. The ingredients are all locally produced and eco-friendly and the noodles homemade to ensure that every bowl, whether it’s a pork belly broth or a light vegetarian mix, is an explosion of umam

places.name: Tranan
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Tranan has been serving Swedish cuisine evergreens since 1929. The fried herring with mashed potatoes has been a fixture on the menu since Tranan's early days, but their classic meatballs in gravy are just as popular. Both a restaurant and a bar, Tranan also hosts the occasional concert, club, or pub quiz.

places.name: Trattorian
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Classic Italian cuisine in an inviting setting. Trattorian is located along the walking route on Norr Mälarstrand and is, along with Orangeriet a vibrant meeting place with lovely outdoor seating areas and proximity to the water.

places.name: Ulla Winbladh
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: ”Ulla, my Ulla.” This is the opening of a famous Swedish ballad by the eighteenth-century troubadour Bellman. The ballad is about his lover, Ulla Winbladh. The restaurant of the same name, with so much tradition behind it, is centrally located on the beautiful and lush island of Djurgården. Traditional Swedish home far

places.name: Villa Godthem
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Villa Godthem in Stockholm’s central Djurgården island was built in 1874 as a private residence for local opera singer Carl Johan Uddman, before it was turned into an inn in 1897. The restaurant is well-known for their Swedish classic cuisine served in fantastic historical settings, and one of their signature dishes is

places.name: Villa Källhagen
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Enjoy a beautiful natural setting and classic cooking with the Djurgård canal just outside the window. The restaurant changes the menu according to the change of seasons and concentrates on contemporary Swedish food. During the summer season, guests gather in the outdoor dining area in the garden, and on Sundays, a pop

places.name: Vina
places.label: Bar
places.note: A menu with both snack-sized tapas and hearty meals. Vina’s passion though is to serve you nature wines from all across Europe, from their dynamic wine list. Wines that are selected to, simply put, put you in a good mood.

places.name: Warung
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: This family-owned restaurant offers Indonesian dishes based on seasonal ingredients from the Swedish nature. In the bustling neighbourhood of Hornstull, owners Nizar Achmad and Anna Lindmark has created an à la carte restaurant that not only has been praised for its nasi goreng and gado gado, but also the creative cock

places.name: Wedholms Fisk
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Delicacies from the sea of the highest quality are served at Wedholms Fisk on Nybrokajen wharf. This gourmet restaurant, which has won an array of honors over the years, is one of the few pure seafood restaurants in Stockholm. The restaurant was founded by the legendary restaurateur Bengt Wedholm. Wedholms has also had

places.name: Woodstockholm
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Furniture store, food bar and bistro in one. Woodstockholm offers a themed menu that that changes regularly, focusing on organically produced food and wine. Small, crowded and very popular. Book in advance or hope for a seat at the bar.

places.name: Xarcuteria
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Relaxed and informal tapas bar in Kungsholmen that offers more than 50 wines by the glass. Old classics are mixed with modern fusion tapas and the charcuterie platter is not to be missed.

places.name: Yuc Mexican
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Yuc Mexican is a haven for lovers of garlic, cilantro, and chili; Mexican-styled fusion food with influences from Peru, Chile, East Asia and Sweden. Be sure to check out the award-winning bar as well!

places.name: Art Bakery
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Art Bakery combines the fine art of creating pastries with, well, fine art. Besides creating desserts that look and taste like no other the café, located in the NK department store, has an exhibition space showcasing contemporary art.

places.name: Bak
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: This bakery started off as a small and luxurious spot in the city – the owners of Bak have been responsible for the dessert at the Nobel Banquet twice. When they moved to larger premises in Hökarängen, they were able to open a spacious café. Visitors can now enjoy the freshly baked pastries on-site while looking at new

places.name: Bergianska gamla orangeriet
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.address: Veit Wittrocks väg 7, Stockholm, Sweden, 114 18 Stockholm
places.note: The old orangery is located in the Bergius Botanic Garden, ideally situated on Brunnsviken near the seaside. Visit for the relaxed atmosphere, the bakery, a great bread buffet– and of course, to see the beautiful old greenhouse.

places.name: Blåbär
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Blåbär is Swedish for blueberry, and the café’s signature drink is blueberry juice. But Blåbär is primarily known for its filling salads, which you can create yourself from a selection of ingredients. Other fare includes soups and grilled sandwiches.

places.name: Bröd & Salt Regeringsgatan
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Bröd & Salt is a local chain of artisan bakeries, with locations all over Stockholm. Everything is fresh, made from sourdough, and lactose-free. Besides fresh bread, buns, and cookies Bröd & Salt also has a selection of fresh salads, sandwiches, and wraps if you’re hungry for lunch!

places.name: Bullar & Bröd Valhallavägen
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Bakery and café with an industrial feel. Go for their popular avocado toast – or try a single espresso, served in the same cup as their homemade gelato. Bullar & Bröd (meaning “buns & bread”) is open seven days a week and the owner was named the best baker in Sweden 2015.

places.name: Café Blå Lotus
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: A little piece of the Orient in SoFo: there are many varieties of tea and coffee to choose from at Café Blå Lotus. They offer sweet home-made pastries and filling sandwiches. The cozy décor is inspired by different parts of the East.

places.name: Café Ektorpet
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Round of a visit to Waldemarsudde’s art museum with a snack in Café Ektorpet’s lush and green garden. The café holds its doors open during the summer months and has a menu of both lighter snacks, lunches, and waffles.

places.name: Café Koya
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Café Koya combines Japanese desserts and cakes, with a love of Japanese popular culture. Have a simple fika - why not a matcha roll or kabocha pumpkin pie with yuzu tea or a matcha latte? - or drop by on one of their workshops to learn more about anime, cosplay or manga.

places.name: Café Pascal Vasastan
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: A block from busy Odenplan, on a quiet corner, you'll find Café Pascal. In 2019 the coffee house won the prestigious Gulddraken award for best café in Stockholm. Great coffee and sandwiches with shrimp or porchetta to die for!

places.name: Café Proviant
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Café Proviant is a restaurant with its own brewery. The food is mainly made by primary products from Swedish farmers. Their focus is to serve great meals and great beer to go with it. Sister restaurant to Proviant at Sturegatan.

places.name: Chaikhana
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Chaikhana in the Old Town (Gamla Stan) serves first-class teas from around the world. Their wide selection includes both delicious classics and lesser-known blends. Drop-in for an Afternoon Tea and a snack, or learn more about the mysteries of tea at one of their tea tastings.

places.name: Chokladkoppen
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: This cozy little café in the heart of Gamla Stan was one of the first openly LGBT-friendly establishments in Stockholm. Exquisite sandwiches and pastries, and in summer a popular alfresco section.

places.name: Cupcake STHLM
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Treat yourself to a playful and yummy cupcake at Cupcake STHLM. The small café serves up classic American cupcakes in all colors and flavor-variations, with a rotating selection of cakes depending on the season.

places.name: Delivore
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: The café Delivore is located inside its sister shop Goodstore; a vegan and vegetarian grocery store with plant-based alternatives for everything you might need in your everyday life. Delivore offers freshly squeezed juice, croissants, pies, wraps, smoothies and other snacks. All vegan, as well.

places.name: Drop Coffee
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: A popular place run by true coffee aficionados with very high focus on quality and craftsmanship. All coffee served is both organic and fair-trade and also roasted in their own award-winning roastery. Two-time winner of Barista Cup.

places.name: Fabrique Klarabergsgatan
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Fabrique is a local chain of traditional wood-fired bakeries that are located throughout central Stockholm. Here you'll find top-quality fresh-baked sourdough bread, rolls, and cakes baked by hand with natural ingredients according to time-honored traditions. Don´t miss out on the famous blueberry buns!

places.name: Fern and Fika
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: The motto of Fern and Fika (previously known as STHLM Raw)  is that everybody deserves a fika every day, but without feeling like your stuffing yourself with unhealthy snacks. Hence, their delicious treats are made without additives, gluten, lactose or granulated sugar and instead filled with eco-friendly and sustainab

places.name: Flickorna Helin
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: A charming café in a secluded and leafy setting with a large and very popular selection of baked goods. The castle-like building is located along the pedestrian path on Djurgården, and it’s a splendid place for lunch or a coffee break between visits to Skansen, the Vasa Museum, and other nearby attractions.

places.name: Fosch Artisan Pâtisserie
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: The brainchild of a classically trained pastry chef and a restaurateur with a childhood spent on farms and fields, Fosch Artisan Pâtisserie has garnered attention for the delicious French pastries and love of fresh and ecological ingredients. This award-winning bakery on Östermalm not only carefully selects the best in

places.name: Gast
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Minimalistic but cozy café located just north of Hötorget. Gast is the sibling of Kaffeverket and Stora bageriet and serves up exciting blends of coffee as well as great buns, sandwiches, and even light lunches.

places.name: Gildas rum
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: The décor is stylishly kitschy, with muted red and gold tones. The bookshelf pattern on the wallpaper and the comfy armchairs lend the feeling of an old-fashioned reading room. The selection of home-baked goodies is popular, as well as the fresh lunch menu. Located in Bohemian SoFo, with popular outdoor seating in the

places.name: Green Rabbit
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Celebrated chefs Mathias Dahlgren and Martin Berg are behind this innovative bakery, where organic ingredients and sustainability are front and center. In addition to bread and baked goods, the Green Rabbit bakery offers breakfast, Swedish varieties of Danish smørrebrød sandwiches and soup for lunch. Playfulness and cu

places.name: Haga Tårtcompani & Bageri – Vasastan
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Haga Tårtcompani & Bageri is an artisan bakery in Stockholm's Vasastan area known for cakes, bread, and classic pastries with a modern twist. Everything from sourdough bread to buns and handcrafted cakes is baked using Swedish flour and carefully selected ingredients. In addition to Swedish fika, the bakery offers cust

places.name: Il Caffé Södermannagatan
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Take a well-deserved coffee break in the heart of busy Södermalm at one of the local’s favorite “fika” spots. Unpretentious and cozy, Il Caffé offers pastries, simple lunches and fresh bread from their own bakery. Check out their other locations, too!

places.name: Java Whiskers
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Java Whiskers is a cat lovers dream. Besides serving coffee and fika the coffee shop in Vasastan serves as a shelter for cats and works towards finding new homes for them. Guests are welcome to pet and cuddle the cats, as long as they follow the rules of the café.

places.name: Johan & Nyström Swedenborgsgatan
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Combined coffee bar, roastery and concept store for coffee aficionados. The fair-trade organic beans are roasted in their own roastery. Try the "roast of the week" or ask the friendly and knowledgeable baristas for personal advice on what to order.

places.name: Kaferang Nytorget
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: The trendy Kaferang has two locations, one in Norrmalm and one in the heart of SoFo at Nytorget. Both serve refreshing snacks and brunch, and hearty lunch sandwiches if your appetite is larger still.

places.name: Kaffe
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Movie and Swedish crime-fans might recognize the cozy Kaffe as Daniel Craig’s coffee bar of choice in the film adaption of The Girl With The Dragon Tattoo. The coffee served is strictly Italian, with bitter espressos and creamy lattes, but the snacks are from all over.

places.name: Stora Bageriet Östermalm
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Stora Bageriet is located on Östermalm in the oldest industrial building in Stockholm; a bakery that used to supply the military with fresh bread. They're open for breakfast, fika and lunch, and their outdoor terrace is perfect for a refreshing drink in the shade.

places.name: Konditori Lyran
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Walk up the stairs in the tower of this 150-year-old sun yellow house and enjoy the stunning views of Mälaren. Lyran is a pastry shop, famous for its shrimp sandwiches and afternoon tea. Famous people who have visited Lyran over the years include King Oskar II and author Selma Lagerlöf.

places.name: Kungsholmens glassfabrik
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: A combination ice cream factory, store, and café just a short walk from City Hall. They make premium ice cream in intriguing flavors that you can either enjoy immediately or take home with you in a small container.

places.name: La Gelateria SoFo
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: La Gelateria SoFo contrasts the harsh cold of northern Sweden with the sunny warmth of Italy. Classic flavors like pistachio and limoncello mingle with nordic newcomers like cloudberries, lingonberries and sea buckthorn. All the ice cream in the store is artisanally made on-site.

places.name: Lasse i Parken
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Not far from the city center in Hornstull you find Lasse i Parken, a green paradise with garden seating for 300 people. The house is from the seventeenth century and inside you´ll find the café. Visit for coffee, lunch or live music during summer.

places.name: Lillebrors bageri
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Tiny bakery with a huge ambiance. The wooden counter takes up most of the space, but in the warmer months guests can enjoy a cup of coffee and the freshly baked pastries outdoors as Rörstrandsgatan turns into a car-free street during summer. Go for a croissant – with 27 layers of dough and butter it will melt as soon a

places.name: Louie Louie
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Named after the rock ’n roll song, Louie Louie features music on stage, for sale, and in the rockabilly decor. The cafe attracts a younger SoFo crowd with sandwiches, pastries, and coffee at reasonable prices.

places.name: Lykke Nytorget
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Lykke Kaffegårdar is on a mission to produce good coffee, made under decent conditions. At Lykke Nytorget you can taste the fruits of their work; the beans are harvested at Lykke's own plantations around the world, and roasted at proprietary roasteries in Berlin and Stockholm.Brunch and home-baked goods are also served

places.name: Mahalo
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Mahalo specializes in plant-based breakfasts and lunches. Enjoy American pancakes and a smoothie at the start of the day or come back later for a fresh lunch bowl or a plate of loaded vegan fries.Mahalo has several locations in Stockholm, including Kungsholmen, Vasastan, and Södermalm.

places.name: MR. Cake
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: MR. Cake brings an American sensibility and style to your Swedish fika. Delicious cinnamon rolls and pastries, fresh sandwiches and salads, and jaw-droppingly beautiful cakes. (They also have locations at Regeringsgatan 57 and Stockholm Central Station.)

places.name: Petite France
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: At the Petite France Bakery, you’ll find an abundance of French specialties: genuine croissants, brioches and several types of pastries. They offer lovely breakfast specials and affordable lunches – all high quality and with a French touch.

places.name: Pom & Flora Södermalm
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: The breakfast deal at Pom & Flora is known to be one of the best in town. The café on the corner of Bondegatan 64 in Södermalm serves up both beautiful interior and a menu worth returning for – whether you're up for breakfast or lunch. They also have a café in Vasastan, on Odengatan.

places.name: Ritorno
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Ritorno is a classic Stockholm bakeshop and café which has been in business since 1959. Today Ritorno is decorated in a warm and welcoming 1950s style, and it's a popular spot for long coffee breaks. Classic Swedish meatball sandwiches complement Ritorno's image as a Stockholm bakeshop where the traditional rules.In ad

places.name: Robin Delselius bageri
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Robin Delselius is a third-generation baker from a family with over 30 years of bakery experience. He continues the family tradition of delicious buns, bread, cookies, and pastries with his own bakeries in Gamla Enskede, Nacka, Kvarnholmen, and Södermalm. They also run a seaside summer café in Stavsnäs. If you're hungr

places.name: Rosendals Garden Café
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Rosendals Trädgård is one of Stockholm’s true gems! The garden café is located in a fantastic setting on Djurgården island and offers salads, soups, sandwiches and pastries made in the bakery next door. The café uses organic and biodynamic ingredients, a lot of them even come from their own garden. Many Stockholmers ma

places.name: Rosenhill
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Rosenhill is a magical, inviting garden outside town. This peaceful family farm produces organic vegetables, apples and apple juice and you can enjoy it all in the garden café. Sit down and relax among the apple trees, nap in a hammock or make your own cider – or stay overnight.

places.name: Saturnus
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: People go to Saturnus to drink large bowls of hot latte with the legendary cinnamon rolls – they are the biggest, and they’ve been described in the press as the best in town. A café and lunch spot with inspiration from France, where the decor has warm colors, a stone's throw from Stureplan and close to cultural attract

places.name: Scarfó
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Genuine artisan gelato, made from a combination of the best ingredients imported from Italy and seasonal Swedish produce. Scarfó is located in Ålsten, an affluent and trendy part of the Bromma suburb, characterized by “Per-Albinhusen”; villas in the style of functionalist architecture. In other words, it’s ample opport

places.name: Skroten
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Skroten started at the old marine store on Skeppsholmen but is now located at the shipyard on beautiful Djurgården. Stop by for a coffee or stay for a bowl of fish stew and a glass of wine. This charming place is worth a visit all year round.

places.name: Snö
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Snö makes traditional Italian gelato, dense and rich in flavor - both unique blends and time-tested classics. Just a stone’s throw from Vasaparken it’s the perfect spot to stock up on delicious ice cream to binge on, during a sunny summer day in Vasastan. They also have a shop on Kvarnholmen island in the Nacka distric

places.name: Stikki Nikki Mariatorget
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Stikki Nikki serves fresh, homemade gelato, ice cream, and sorbet. Stikki Nikki has several ice cream cafés around Stockholm; for instance on Götgatan, Drottninggatan and Mariatorget.

places.name: Stockholms glasshus
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: With its large selection, long experience, and extraordinary craftsmanship, this place lives up to its name - which means "The Stockholm Ice Cream House." There are about 40 flavors of ice cream, gelato, sorbet and other tasty treats on the menu, and plenty of seating.

places.name: Tössebageriet
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Occupying the same address since 1920, Tössebageriet is well-known as one of Stockholm's most historic classic bakeshops. Take a lunch break with a sandwich made from home-made bread in the cozy bakeshop atmosphere, or enjoy a pastry if you're able to choose from among their tempting creations. They have everything in

places.name: Vetekatten Kungsgatan
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Vetekatten in central Stockholm is a coffee-and-pastry institution. A well-preserved, tradition-packed café where you can sample traditional Swedish pastries of superior quality. They have six branches throughout the city and their first has been open, almost every day, since opening its door at Kungsgatan 55 in 1928.

places.name: Vintervikens Trädgård
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Take a break from city life and head to a green oasis. Just a few stops by subway from the city center you will find Vintervikens Trädgård: an inspiring garden and organic café where you can simply enjoy the sound of the breeze in the trees. Open all year round.

places.name: Vurma
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: High cozy factor among the colorful interiors. With a personal and friendly style, considerate staff and tasty sandwiches with names like ‘buddy’, ‘stranger’ and ‘scruffy’, Vurma has become a popular spot for many locals in Hornstull.

places.name: Winterviken
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
