places.note: In the suburb of Aspudden, in an old Nobel-factory from 1891, you find the popular café Winterviken. Located just a short train ride from the center but close to nature, this is the perfect place for a small excursion away from the city life. Open every day, all through the year.

places.name: Zetas
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Zetas is an inspiring destination outside town where you can explore a beautiful garden, buy plants and indoor and outdoor furnishing - or enjoy a lunch or coffee in the lush settings.

places.name: 20hundra5
places.label: Bar
places.note: Small and cozy but fully stocked with everything to make a fantastic drink and then some! The award-winning 20hundra5 has created quite a buzz since it opened its doors. Both for their own creations – like a Windom Earle or a H.Y.S.H – or their take on cocktail classics. And while you’re there, why not take a jab impro

places.name: Americain
places.label: Bar
places.note: The cocktail bar Americain draws inspiration from 1920's American ballrooms and hotels. Located in the Haymarket-hotel the bar serves classy and elegant drinks, simple dishes and offers an elegant vibe with live music.

places.name: Brasserie Godot
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: The favorite joint of well-to-do Stockholmers. Brasserie Godot was established in 2001 with the aim of opening a classic French brasserie with the city’s best bar. The bar has a huge drink list focusing on fresh fruit and berries. The small dining room is simple and stylish, serving classics, seafood, and a three-cours

places.name: Cadierbaren Grand Hôtel
places.label: Bar
places.note: Luxurious, elegantly cozy bar with comfortable sofa groups and ravishing views of the water and the Royal Palace. Innovative bar menu and popular weekend brunch and Afternoon Tea. A classic Stockholm experience.

places.name: Café Opera
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Everyone who is anyone has partied here, and quite a few nobodies, beneath the famous crystal chandeliers. This recently renovated club is housed in magnificent interior spaces in the Opera House, adjacent to with the equally famous Operakällaren restaurant.

places.name: Corner Club
places.label: Bar
places.note: A cozy at-home feeling and friendly bartenders behind the bar will guarantee a great time at Corner Club. The bar’s creed is to keep things simple and to have a drink list as varied and dynamic as the seasons themselves. If you get hungry, you can either order a burger or snacks from the bar or go downstairs to the gas

places.name: Debaser Pontonen
places.label: Bar
places.note: When beloved rock club Debaser opened up a new open-air bar, it quickly became one of the hottest summer hang-outs in Stockholm, and not just because of the warm weather. Located in the waters in front of Debaser, Pontonen serves light summer dishes, refreshing drinks, and artisan ice cream from King Scoopa. Expect DJs

places.name: Erlands
places.label: Bar
places.note: Café and cocktail bar in vintage style, where everything from the music to the bartender´s outfit is from the 50´s and 60´s. Although the ambiance most definitely inspires to ordering high-quality cocktails, you can also enjoy wine, beer, and snacks.

places.name: Chewie's Bar
places.label: Bar
places.note: Chewies Bar on Kungsholmen serves natural wines and craft beer in a homey and cozy atmosphere. Even dogs are allowed inside, as Chewies has a special brew made just for your four-legged companion.

places.name: Gården Bar & Grill
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Bar and restaurant in the middle of the city - the perfect place for a beer with friends. Gården Bar & Grill is located in a former schoolyard by Norra Bantorget, close to Drottninggatan. Great location and a safe bet when you feel like having a snack, dinner, or drinks in the city center.

places.name: Grand Central by Scandic
places.label: Bar
places.note: Trendy New York-inspired hotel bar in downtown Stockholm near Central Station. Grand Central by Scandic draws hotel guests as well as Stockholm locals who come in for a drink after work - and there is plenty of room for all. If not in the bar, in the lobby or one floor up. The hotel restaurant, Teaterbrasseriet, is on

places.name: Guldbaren, Nobis Hotel
places.label: Bar
places.note: Guldbaren, (The Gold bar) at the five-star Nobis Hotel is as elegant as it sounds. The walls and ceiling are covered with gold-framed mirrors and the cocktails are master-class. Hang out at the bar or relax on a sofa in the beautiful atrium right next to it.

places.name: Himlen
places.label: Bar
places.note: Elegant, luxurious cocktail lounge and sky bar with spectacular 360-degree views of Stockholm, from the top of a skyscraper in Södermalm. Also a stylish restaurant.

places.name: Hornstulls Bodega
places.label: Bar
places.note: Hornstulls Bodega is the popular restaurant Tjogets wine bar. As the name suggests – “bodega” is a Spanish storehouse for aging wine – the bar is an unpretentious haven for wine connoisseurs. The bar likes to keep its winelist ever-changing with the only requirements being that wines are from Europe and, of course, del

places.name: Icebar Stockholm by Icehotel
places.label: Bar
places.note: The planet’s first permanent ice bar, made of ice from the world-famous Icehotel in Jukkasjärvi, Lapland. Everything except the liquids in the drinks is made of ice, and the temperature is kept at a constant 23 degrees Fahrenheit.

places.name: Judit & Bertil
places.label: Bar
places.note: A warm, homey atmosphere prevails at Judit & Bertil. This is the place to encounter locals eating affordable well-prepared food in a relaxed setting. The bar is also very popular. All in honor of the real Judit & Bertil, the maternal grandparents of one of the owners.

places.name: Katarina Ölkafé
places.label: Bar
places.note: Located on Katarina Bangata is this snug beer pub that has succeeded in the art of being both personal and trendy. The beer comes from ultralocal microbreweries, and the snacks come in great flavors. Especially the pastrami sandwiches are much talked about. In the summer there is a small sidewalk cafe.

places.name: Kvarnen
places.label: Bar
places.note: Legendary restaurant, bar, and waterhole with a century’s history, in the old blue-collar district of Södermalm. Enjoy well-made, classic Swedish fare in a beautiful setting, with high ceilings and plenty of patina. Kvarnen is also featured in Stieg Larsson's Millennium-books as the meeting place for Lisbeth Salander a

places.name: Le Hibou
places.label: Bar
places.note: Le Hibou is a rooftop bar, located centrally, in the Bank Hotel. An elegant setting, lovely drinks, and a stunning view make it a perfect little oasis in the bustling heart of Stockholm.

places.name: Lemon Bar
places.label: Bar
places.note: A gem of a bar in a popular Kungsholmen neighborhood. The small bar has a good atmosphere and a mix of guests. With a focus on Swedish pop hits, you can come here any day of the week and dance.

places.name: Lilla Hotellbaren
places.label: Bar
places.note: A spacious, elegant lounge on the ground floor of Scandic Malmen. The modern style suits all occasions and the central location by Medborgarplatsen on Södermalm is a good place to meet friends for a drink. Live music and DJs several nights a week. Mostly jazz.

places.name: Lucy's Flower Shop
places.label: Bar
places.note: Find the entrance, hope to be let in and then walk through the abandoned flower shop and try to locate the hidden door that leads you to the bar. If you succeed, you'll step into a purple world with subtle lightning and a short, yet impressive cocktail menu. Your drink will be served with a presentation of every ingred

places.name: Morfar Ginko
places.label: Bar
places.note: Morfar Ginko is one of Stockholm’s most popular bars. It’s a place for mingling, hanging out, or even playing a game of ping-pong. The DJ works from a loft above the bar, which makes the place feel roomy. There’s a courtyard open in the summer and a great bar done up entirely in white downstairs.

places.name: Mosebacketerrassen
places.label: Bar
places.note: Södra Teatern’s terrace is a classic among locals spending the summer in Stockholm. Here, you can enjoy good food, cold brews, and great company—all with a stunning view over the city.

places.name: Musikaliska Gård
places.label: Bar
places.note: Musikaliska Gård has a trendy and large courtyard in a traditional and beautiful environment at Nybrokajen, where music lovers mingle with the capital’s jet-setters. Fridays and Saturdays are club nights, and although the place is crowded, there’s plenty of room to dance and scope out the bar scene.

places.name: Omnipollos Hatt
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: This award-winning brewery and bar is the place to go when you´re up for trying interesting beers with a tasty slice of pizza. Each new week brings new beer, ale, and stouts to the taps and new toppings for the pizzas.

places.name: Orangeriet
places.label: Bar
places.note: This convivial cocktail bar and outdoor cafe are located on Norr Mälarstrand seafront. The bartenders are topnotch, and the stylish décor is reminiscent of English gardens.

places.name: Pharmarium
places.label: Bar
places.note: At Pharmarium, right on Stortorget in the Old Town, the choice of cocktails determines the choice of food. Signature cocktails are served along with well prepared medium-sized dishes composed of seasonal ingredients and traditional medicinal herbs. The bar is inspired by Sweden's first pharmacy, which opened to the pub

places.name: Riche
places.label: Bar
places.note: Classic meeting place in the city center, with multiple bars and restaurants. Stockholm’s art, fashion and club crowds gather here to see and be seen.

places.name: Sailor Bar
places.label: Bar
places.note: This small, intimate rooftop terrace at at Scandic Sjöfartshotellet near Slussen has a playful Caribbean sailor theme to it. Sit down and enjoy your glass of champagne by the Stockholm waterfront.

places.name: Södra Teatern
places.label: Bar
places.note: Södra Teatern at Mosebacke is a classic meeting point with a modern atmosphere. Here you’ll find stage shows, live concerts, nightclubs, culinary experiences, and a great vibe—all under one roof. Come to relax, discover something new, or dance the night away. With an impressive view of Stockholm, you can enjoy warm sum

places.name: Stampen Jazzpub
places.label: Bar
places.note: Stampen is a cozy pub for a mix of folk. All the swing, Dixie, trad, blues, and 50-60s rock enthusiasts gather here. With two floors, two stages, and two crowded bars, it is definitely worth a visit if you’re interested in music. Live music daily.

places.name: Stigbergets Fot
places.label: Bar
places.note: Stigbergets Fot offers 24 taps with experimental craft beer from their own brewery as well as local and international guests. Originally a brewery from the Swedish west-coast, this location opened in February 2020 and is run in collaboration with Barrels Burgers & Beers. Not so fond of beer? Don't worry, Stigbergets Fo

places.name: Stockholm under Stjärnorna
places.label: Bar
places.note: Stockholm under the stars - SUS - is a rooftop bar located in the middle of Stockholm, just a short walk from either the T-Centralen or Kungsträdgården metro station. A mixed crowd, relaxed atmosphere, good drinks and great music (with sets that are regularly broadcast on their Facebook page) makes SUS a great hang out

places.name: Story Hotel
places.label: Bar
places.note: The spacious bar at the trendy Story Hotel is a popular after-work scene for the city crowd. A cool, jazzy atmosphere during the week heats up from Thursday to Saturday, when the DJs step up the beat. The adjacent restaurant "Ling Long" has quickly become a favorite among locals, serving creative dishes from the Asian

places.name: Tiki Room
places.label: Bar
places.note: A tropical oasis in the heart of Stockholm, Tiki Room is Stockholm’s only Tiki bar. Great drinks, relaxing exotica-music and a soothing atmosphere. If you’re in dire need of a quick fix of some Hawaiian-beach party vibes, Tiki Room is the place for you.

places.name: Tjoget
places.label: Bar
places.note: Tjoget is an interesting combination of restaurant, wine bar, and beer café. The restaurant has a relaxed atmosphere and a vibrant bar that has quickly become popular among the residents of Hornstull in Södermalm. Order a perfectly composed cocktail or take your pick among the carefully selected beers or vines. The bar

places.name: Takpark by Urban Deli
places.label: Bar
places.note: The popular restaurant concept Urban Deli manage their own rooftop bar at Sveavägen, called Höjden (meaning "the height"), on the 9th floor. Go for the cocktails, the view, or just the complete experience. Open all year round.

places.name: India's
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: India's is an elegant take on colorful and spicy Indian cuisine, mixed with Swedish produce. Traditional dishes like daal, seekh, and chaat meet ingredients like perch, deer, halibut, and Västerbotten cheese. The bar serves evergreen drinks with a spicy twist, like a "Curry Colada" or "Kashmir Spicy Margarita".

places.name: Wirströms Pub
places.label: Bar
places.note: Live music Tuesday through Saturday in a classic pub setting. Wirströms pub has become a popular hangout for Stockholm’s large English-speaking population. They have a large selection of beers and arrange whiskey tastings.

places.name: The Secret Garden
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: The Secret Garden is an honest and open-minded bar, restaurant and nightclub in the heart of Stockholm - Gamla Stan. Have a quiet dinner in their hidden garden, a glass or two with a view, a fun night of dancing, or all of it. They're open every day from 12 to 03, and their DJ's are playing beats Wednesdays through Sat

places.name: Kaffebar
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Kaffebar, formerly known as Mellqvists Kaffebar, is a cozy coffee shop on Södermalm known for its excellent coffee and great atmosphere. It's was also for being Stieg Larsson's real-life hangout and is prominently featured in the Millenium books. Perhaps this is the very place where he sat and developed the plots of th

places.name: Magasinet i Vaxholm
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Magasinet, located on the waterfront in idyllic Vaxholm, is more than a restaurant serving hungry archipelago-visitors. The old smithy has been turned into a yoga studio, design shop, and bistro, serving lunch every day and brunch on weekends.

places.name: Café Uddvillan
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Finish (or start) a lovely walk in Vinterviken, with some coffee and raspberry pie at Café Uddvillan. The café is located in an old mansion overlooking lake Mälaren, offering some rustic charm in the suburb of Hägersten.

places.name: Enskedeparkens Bageri
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Enskedeparkens Bageri lies in the suburbian villa idyll of Enskede, next to a riding school and allotment gardens. The café is small, with only a few tables, but the patio is open all-year-round and their famous cinnamon buns are worth a trip alone, no matter the weather.

places.name: Chelas
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Chelas is Mexican slang for beer, and that gives you a hint of what this trendy restaurant is all about: Mexican food and drinks. The beer-battered fish tacos are a favorite among Hornstull locals who have made Chelas their go-to restaurant. Dogs are also welcome!

places.name: Brasserie Astoria
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Brasserie Astoria on Nybrogatan is Michelin-starred chef Björn Frantzén’s latest Stockholm endeavor. Housed in a former cinema, Astoria is opts for a more relaxed dinner experience than the inventive kitchen wizardy at three starred Frantzén. You’ll be treated to classic dishes from the French and Italian culinary trad

places.name: Svartsö Krog
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: The season and available ingredients guide the menu at Svartsö Krog. The rustic restaurant lies on the island of Svartsö in the central archipelago. The restaurant also operates a glamping site, if you'd like to spend a night or two on this idyllic island in style.

places.name: Spesso
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Spesso is Italian for "often" and the ambition of this centrally located rooftop restaurant is to be a place diners gladly return to, meal after meal. The panoramic view of Stockholm is accompanied by modern Italian dishes, made on seasonal ingredients.

places.name: Liebling
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Liebling on Södermalm is a german bistro, through and through. Schnitzel, kroketten, maultaschen, kartoffel and apfelkuchen. Served, naturally, with pilsner and the best german wines.

places.name: Ai Ramen Klara
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: One of Stockholm's best ramen bars, Ai Ramen has served mouth-watering noodle bowls, gyoza, and saké since 2015. And in that time it has become one of Södermalm's most popular hang-out spots, either to grab a lunch, dinner or an evening drink. In 2019 Ai Ramen opened a second location in the center of Stockholm on Gaml

places.name: Båtshaket
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Located in and old boathouse on Utö, Båtshaket is just what you would expect from a restaurant in the Stockholm Archipelago; Fresh seafood (smoked in their own smokery) served in an atmospheric restaurant, with a great view of the open sea.

places.name: Restaurang Kroken
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Family-owned Restaurang Kroken can be found by the water in Nynäshamns marina, a perfect little archipelago-tip for anyone who prefers to travel by public transportation. The menu offers classic Swedish cuisine, fresh seafood, and tasty drinks.

places.name: Gojo
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Gojo can be found at the eastern end of Ringvägen at Södermalm, sitting at the foot of Vitabergsparken. The menu offers West African flavors and stews to be eaten with traditional fermented injera-bread.

places.name: Kattholmen
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Kattholmen is housed in what was originally built to be a small power plant, supplying the Gustavsberg porcelain factory with electricity. The interior still shows signs of the building's industrial history and the menu is a blend of Scandinavian flavors and international favorites.

places.name: La Piccola Nonna
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: La Piccola Nonna started out as a pizzeria-on-wheels before getting a permanent residence on Södermalm, just a short walk from Medborgarplatsen. The restaurant bakes Neapolitan-inspired pizzas but with a twist; all pies are vegetarian or vegan.

places.name: Skrovet
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Situated on the bank of Årstaviken, Skrovet is a seasonal restaurant open from April to October. Enjoy a balmy summer sunset at their outdoor area with a simple bar dish and a nice glass of wine or beer.

places.name: Checa
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Checa is a small neighborhood restaurant on Södermalm with a large passion for Peruvian cuisine. Enjoy fried yucas, tiradito-salmon, lomo, and a selection of ceviche-bowls to eat, and pisco sour to drink.

places.name: China!
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Restaurant China! on Södermalm, instantly recognizable by the round gazebo protruding from the building, serves traditional Chinese cuisine. Enjoy Thousand Year Egg, Mooncake, dumplings and their homemade tofu with a glass of beer brewed at their sister-restaurant on Kungsholmen.

places.name: Bröd & Salt Luma
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Bröd & Salt is a local chain of artisan bakeries, with locations all over Stockholm. Everything is fresh, made from sourdough, and lactose-free. Besides fresh bread, buns, and cookies Bröd & Salt also has a selection of fresh salads, sandwiches, and wraps if you’re hungry for lunch!

places.name: Solstugan
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Solstugan is a classic summer hangout. Having been around since 1922, the restaurant and bar is perfect for anyone who wants to enjoy a summer sunset with a beautiful view of Lake Mälaren. Solstugan usually opens for the season in late April and stays open during the summer months.

places.name: Grinda Wärdshus
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Grinda Wärdshus, an inn on the popular island of Grinda near Vaxholm, has a reputation as being one of the best restaurants in the Stockholm archipelago. Fresh seasonal ingredients in both typical and innovative takes on the cuisine of the archipelago. The inn also operates a summer drop-in restaurant, Framfickan, and

places.name: Nynäs Rökeri
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Award-winning Nynäs Rökeri is a family-owned restaurant, smokehouse, and seafood deli. Besides smoked fish and shrimp – caught in the waters of the Stockholm Archipelago – you'll find pickled herring, gravlax fried herring, and other Swedish seafood classics.

places.name: Slottsträdgården Ulriksdal
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Slottsträdgården Ulriksdal is a garden shop and café just a stone's throw from Ulriksdal Palace. Enjoy a locally sourced lunch or fika, find beautiful plants and handy tools for your garden, and (if you're visiting during the summer or fall) pick your own flowers and vegetables at the free land plantings.

places.name: Kanaans Trädgårdscafé
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: At the edge of Grimsta nature reserve, just a stone's throw from the Kanaan public beach, you'll find Kanaans trädgårdscafé overlooking Lake Mälaren. The indoor café is open all-year round but in the spring and summer the café opens up its outdoor area and garden bar, as well as its petanque-courses.

places.name: Pontonen
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Pontonen is a centrally located summerbar att Norr Mälarstrand on Kungsholmen. Have a fresh cocktail and modern Swedish food while enjoying the view of Lake Mälaren and Södermalm.

places.name: Chili Masala
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Chili Masala in the suburb of Solna specializes in punjabi-cuisine from the region of the same name in India and Pakistan. Well-seasoned Karai, Tikka and Tawa-dishes cooked the traditional way in a degh-pan.

places.name: Amida
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Popular street-food joint Amida has been serving Turkish barbecue staples like döner, falafel, köfte, and iskender since 2002. The original restaurant is on Folkungagatan on Södermalm but you'll also find them in Kungens Kurva, Sollentuna and Sundbyberg.

places.name: Minh Mat
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Minh Mat serves typical Vietnamese dishes – frogs legs, autumn rolls, and deep-fried tofu – in the traditional "ăn chơi"-style. The restaurant is located on Odengatan just by Vasaparkan, just a short walk from S:t Eriksplan metro station.

places.name: Eatnam
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Eatnam serves Vietnamese-cuisine, with ingredients and spices inspired by the everyday food in Saigon. Pho-soup, banh mi-sandwiches, fresh spring rolls and noodle salad. The restaurant originally opened on Odengatan but also has locations on Östermalm and Södermalm.

places.name: Saigon Baguette Gamla Brogatan
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Popular Saigon Baguette in central Stockholm specializes in spicy bánh mi-sandwiches: crispy baguettes filled with vegetables, fresh herbs and chili, and marinated meat or tofu. The menu also offers various rice and noodle-dishes, Pho-soup, bubble tea, ice coffee, and Vietnamese beer, rice vodka and rice wine.

places.name: Esperia
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Esperia on Sankt Paulsgatan serves genuine Greek cuisine in a relaxed environment. Either order several small dishes (mezatas) to share with your company, or order a larger dish. You'll find staples like souvláki, saganáki, orzo and deep-fried calamari on the menu.

places.name: Nostimo
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Greek cafés are a rarity in Stockholm, but Nostimo on Sveavägen is just that. The menu offer both lunches – gyros and spanakopita (spinach and feta cheese pie) – and bougatsa pastries with either Fred espresso or regular coffee.

places.name: Restaurang Cypern
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Cypriot cuisine is heavily influenced by both Greek and Turkish food, something you'll be able to experience first-hand at Restaurang Cypern on Valhallavägen. Moussaka, bifteki, halloumi, or a fresh salad as a main, followed by a baklava or yoghurt mastiha for dessert.

places.name: Wäng Izakaya
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Pan-Asian restaurant Wäng Izakaya is all about the beloved classics of Asian cuisine. Japanese sushi and sashimi, Korean bibimbap-bowls, spicy fried rice from Singapore, Pad Thai from Thailand, or Vietnamese Pho-soup. You can have them all, in one place.

places.name: Machi Machi
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Machi Machi is a tea house catering to sweet-tooths. Choose between Créme Brulee, Strawberry with cream cheese, or a zesty tea with fresh fruits. They also have a large selection of Taiwanese "boba teas"; flavored teas with sweet and chewy tapioca bubbles.

places.name: Indio
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Indio is Sweden's first Nikkei-restaurant; a fusion between Japanese and Peruvian culinary traditions that arose in the late 18th century when farmers from Japan emigrated across the Pacific to Peru. The menu features, among other delicacies, unique sushi and sashimi and Nikkei-style ceviche and tiradito.

places.name: Ninecha Milk Tea
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Ninecha Milk Tea on Katarinagatan serves chilled tea drinks in various flavors. Refreshingly fruity, creamy or in different sweet bubble tea-variants.

places.name: Yi Fang
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: The bubble tea-café Yi Fang serves fruity and refreshing drinks made from only natural ingredients. Fresh fruit, cane sugar, and their homemade tapioca pearls cooked every morning before opening hours,

places.name: Cha Talk
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Popular Cha Talk in Vasastan serves bubble tea, juice tea and flavored milk tea in various blends. For a lighter snack there are also egg waffles on the menu to go with your drink.

places.name: Prime Burgers & Smokehouse
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Stockholm-based Prime Burger has several restaurants in inner-city Stockholm. Besides juicy burger (vegetarian or vegan options available, as well) they also serve smoked meats such as baby back ribs, beef brisket and pork belly.

places.name: Glassverkstan
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Glassverkstan crafts its own artisan gelato in a former barn, now transformed into an ice cream bar. It was previously located at Skeppsholmen.

places.name: Pang Pang Taproom
places.label: Bar
places.note: Pang Pang has been making IPA, stout, and lager since 2010 and was one of the first microbreweries to gain traction during the Swedish beer renaissance of the 2010s. In the summer of 2021, Pang Pang opened a small taproom in its Hökarängen brewery, serving beer and ice slush to drink and dumplings to chow. The bar is o

places.name: Aryam
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Award-winning ice cream parlor Aryam was founded by Hosanna Amanuel, a pastry chef and baker by trade, in 2020. Since then it has served tasty Italian-style gelato, made from fresh ingredients.

places.name: Chiôi
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Chiôi is a popular Vietnamese expression that roughly means “hey, sister!”. Its menu consists of traditional and homey Vietnamese cuisine ­– like Pho-soup and Bánh Xèo-crêpes – and many of the recipes have been passed down through generations, from grandmothers to mothers.

places.name: Le Petit Cochon
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Le Petit Cochon is a bistro in the french mold, located on Norrtullsgatan in Vasastan. The menu strives to be playful, unexpected and features delicacies from not only France but southern Europe in general.

places.name: Man in the Moon
places.label: Bar
places.note: Popular gastropub Man in the Moon has one of Stockholm's largest selections of beer; 650 different kinds of which 30 are on tap. There's also a large selection of whiskey with around 110 single malts to chose from. Hungry guests can expect a menu that mixes Swedish classics – like Beef Rydberg and potato pancake – with

places.name: Blå+
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: When Liljevalchs opened its new annex in 2021, the art hall also inaugurated its new museum restaurant Blå+. Blå+ is a branch of the classic Djurgården eatery Blå Porten. Unlike its older sibling, Blå+ is a wholly vegetarian experience though, with a new menu of green and organic dishes every week.

places.name: Bobergs Matsal
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Classic Bobergs Matsal was architect Ferdinand Boberg's last project before his retirement. The lunch restaurant, located in the NK department store, was completed in 1915 and its early 20th-century interior breathes elegance and fine dining. Since 2015 Bobergs is owned by Björn Frantzén, of Frantzén fame, and serves F

places.name: Magnus Johansson Bageri & Konditori
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Magnus Johansson has made dessert for the Nobel banquet a total of 11 times, which makes him the current record holder! At his own café and bakery in Hammarby Sjöstad you'll get a taste of his pastries, cakes, cookies, bread and buns. Also in Hammarby Sjöstad, just a stone's throw away, you'll find Magnus Johansson Gla

places.name: Villa Wera
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: The breakfast and lunch restaurant Villa Wera in Solna describe their menu as “homemade 2.0”; beloved classics and contemporary dishes made with great craftsmanship and from carefully selected produce.

places.name: Café Pascal Södermalm
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Café Pascal has four locations; Odenplan and Gävlegatan in Vasastan, Skånegatan on Södermalm, and Sturegatan in Östermalm. All are defined by their generous sandwiches, a large selection of pastries, and freshly brewed coffee.

places.name: Nour
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Nour is a stylish but intimate restaurant best described as alternative fine dining. Restaurant manager Sayan Isaksson – known for Michelin-starred Esperanto and Imouto – describes the feeling as "coming home to someone for dinner". The cuisine is Nordic with Japanese influences, with ingredients following the changing

places.name: Två Små Svin
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Två Små Svin has specialized in Danish smørrebrøds with various tasty toppings. The small restaurant in the suburb of Årsta also serves Chech beer, and akvavit, and schnaps from its own distillery.

places.name: Knut
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: At Knut restaurant and bar in central Stockholm, guests can enjoy northern Swedish cuisine and try various specialties and delicacies such as game stew, minced moose steak, northern Swedish style pizza. Knut has two locations; at Upplandsgatan 17, and Regeringsgatan where brunch is served every Saturday between 11.30 a

places.name: Texas Longhorn Gamla Stan
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Texas Longhorn is a Swedish chain of steakhouse restaurants focused on American bbq classics. Burgers, ribs, bangers, and steaks with a side of fries, coleslaw, or mac 'n cheese. There are several locations in Stockholm; Gamla Stan, Flemminggatan, Hornsbergs Strand, and Upplandsgatan to name a few.

places.name: Hernö Gin Bar
places.label: Bar
places.note: Award-winning Hernö Gin became Sweden's first gin distillery in 2011, and in 2021 the company opened a bar at Södermalm in Stockholm. Focusing unsurprisingly on gin drinks and cocktails, both classics and new creations, the bar also has a light menu with snacks and smaller dishes.

places.name: Omayma
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: It's never too late to start your day at Omayma, a café on Södermalm that serves breakfast all day long. The menu has many vegan and gluten-free options, and they also serve lunch, fika, and weekend brunch.

places.name: Coquetel Social
places.label: Bar
places.note: Cocktailbar Coquetel Social on Stureplan is a classy, yet homey bar, serving wine, beer and classics drinks. If your behind on trying out a Whiskey Sour, Gibson, Daiquiri, Godfather, Cosmopolitan or Side Car this is a great place to start.

places.name: Restaurang Nabo
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Just next to Tegnérlunden Park, in central Stockholm, you'll find Restaurang Nabo; a spacious brasserie that still has that homey feeling of a neighborhood restaurant. The menu is a mix of Swedish flavors, restaurant classics, great wines, and innovative cocktails.

places.name: Bar Apropos
places.label: Bar
places.note: Cozy Bar Apropos in the Vasastan district harkens back to the prohibition years of the 1920s and secret speakeasy bars. A light menu bar menu with snacks and Tarte flambé, beer, wine, and a mix of drinks that are both new inventions and reimaginings of cocktail classics. And if you ask nicely, the bartender might guide

places.name: PS Vin & Mat
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: For over 20 years PS has run a studio for cooking classes, conferences, and private events at Nytorget. Since 2020 they also run a restaurant, catering to everybody who likes a tasty meal with a glass of exciting wine. The cuisine is a blend of dishes from Sweden, the Mediterranean, and the Middle East and the wine lis

places.name: Moyagi
places.label: Bar
places.note: Karaoke bar Moyagi is located in central Stockholm, at Brunkebergs square. Every party gets their own room, with sound equipment, widescreen tv, tables, and comfortable sofas. Song selection can be made through the Singa-app, food, and beverage orders are made through a tablet in the room. Besides beer, wine, and drink

places.name: Matsu Sushi Bar
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: The small sushi parlor is almost in the middle of the long, long Hornsgatan street on Södermalm. Its relative closeness to Skinnarviksberget and Mariatorget makes the restaurant a great place for take-away lunch on a warm on a beautiful day.

places.name: Dionysos
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Dionysos on Södermalm is one of the oldest greek restaurants in Stockholm, having opened in 1974. The menu offers classic dishes like souvlaki, biffteki and typical greek seafood dishes.

places.name: Bistro Marie
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: French, Italian and Swedish culinary tradition all come together at Bistro Marie, for a relaxed dinner with something tasty for everyone. The restaurant also has a well-stocked wine cooler and a generous menu of refreshing drinks.

places.name: Östergårds
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Östergårds is a former estate-turned-conference center and events space for private receptions and parties. You'll also find a popular restaurant here that serves both lunch and dinner.

places.name: Peppar
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Peppar is a beloved restaurant in Vasastan known for its American-inspired menu and its garish and kitschy interior. Peppar's over-the-top Christmas decorations have become something of a holiday tradition.

places.name: Söderbergs Bageri
places.label: Café
places.note: At Söderbergs Bakery near Telefonplan, you will find a wide range of bread, buns, and cakes. They also offer freshly roasted 100% organic coffee that you can enjoy on the outdoor terrace or as a takeaway.

places.name: Il Caffé Drottninggatan
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Take a well-deserved coffee break in the heart of busy Norrmalm at one of the local’s favorite “fika” spots. Unpretentious and cozy, Il Caffé offers pastries, simple lunches, and fresh bread from its own bakery. Check out their other locations, too!

places.name: Kaferang Gamla Brogatan
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: The trendy Kaferang has two locations, one in Norrmalm and one in the heart of SoFo at Nytorget. Both serve refreshing snacks and brunch, and hearty lunch sandwiches if your appetite is larger.

places.name: Restaurang Artes
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Artes is a Spanish restaurant located in Kulturhuset, but with a separate entrance from Drottninggatan. The menu is mainly Spanish, with a small selection of mains and quite a few smaller tapas-dishes to chose from.

places.name: Mancini
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Mancini on Tunnelgatan has been hailed as the best Italian restaurant in Sweden by Gambero Rosso magazine. The menu is genuinely Italian and is accompanied by a wine list with a bottle of delicious bianchi, rossi, spumati, or dessert wine to go with any meal.

places.name: Ricordi
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Italian restaurant Ricordi leans on memories, both with an interior that breathes vintage elegance and a name that translates to "memories", for a dinner experience that you'll hopefully remember for a long time. The menu is modern Italian; timeless classics with a twist.

places.name: Italienaren i Gubbängen
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: In a short period of time, Italienaren i Gubbängen has become the obvious weekend-hangout spot for the residents of the Stockholm suburb of Gubbängen. The small café is also a gelateria, pizzeria and Italian deli all rolled up into one. The ice cream is made on-site and is classically creamy Italian gelato and sorbet.

places.name: Restaurang Drama
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Restaurang Drama is a bistro located at the Filmstaden Scandinavia-multiplex movie theater in Solna. Enjoy drinks, something to eat or order something to bring with you into the Scandinavia's VIP-cinema.

places.name: La Belle Epoque
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Situated in the Kung Carl Hotel, right by famed night-life area Stureplan, La Belle Epoque is one of Stockholm's newest French-inspired bistros. They specialize in mussels or, as it is more commonly known, moules. With Northern Atlantic being the menu's backbone you will also find other frequent regulars on the menu su

places.name: Coup d'Etat
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Restaurateur Erik Videgård has, for several decades, introduced new cuisines to the Swedish masses and has run a wide variety of successful restaurants with eclectic orientations. The Coup d'Etat restaurant aims to create something luxurious and appealing to everyone, with Persian cuisine as its foundation and influenc

places.name: Gazza
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Gazza is a spaghetteria with craft pasta at its core. The menu varies, but can include anolini – small saucers filled with liquid parmesan – or ravioli with rabbit ragu, lardo and sage. They spend days making the foccacia just right and the espresso machine is, of course, imported straight from Milano. If you're not on

places.name: Hasselsons
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: "Fast food from the sea" is the Hasselson motto. From its humble beginnings as a hole-in-the-wall food hatch in the Gothenburg archipelago, Hasselsson has now finally established himself in Stockholm. The short but sweet menu includes seafood super hits such as moules frites, fish & chips as well as their crispy fish b

places.name: Panem
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Panem is latin for "bread" and fittingly enough also a bakery in Gamla stan, serving up freshly baked bread, rolls and buns everyday. Panem also doubles as a bistro with a menu of lighter snacks, like sandwiches and pizza slices, with a glass of beer or wine.

places.name: Röda Huset
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Restaurant and bar Röda Huset (literally: "The Red House") is located fittingly enough in the red building overlooking Sergels Torg from Malmskillnadsgatan. The drink menu is designed by award-winning bartender Hampus Thunholm and incorporates local flavors from Sweden like carrots, plums, and raspberries.

places.name: Maxos
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: "The best falafel in town" is a confident slogan, but the long lines around lunchtime prove that Maxos delivers what they promise. Of course, middle-east staples such as merguez and börek are served here. Besides, the owners swear that the entire menu is just as delicious as in the town Akko – "the gastronomic heart of

places.name: Soth's Kitchen
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Soth's Kitchen is located at Courtyard by Marriott, on Kungsholmen. As an all-day eatery, guests are welcome for breakfast, lunch, or a relaxing dinner. The menu is grounded in Swedish seasonal cooking but with international influences.

places.name: Omnipollos Flora
places.label: Bar
places.note: Omnipollos Flora, run by Stockholm craft brewery Omnipollo, mixes relaxed bar vibes with an inner-city picnic. Open during spring and summer in Humlegården, the bar serves unique brews under the lush, green foliage of the park's trees. Don't miss the ice cream.

places.name: Ramen Ki-mama
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Ramen Ki-mama precedes the Swedish ramen trend by almost 20 years. The small restaurant opened up in the early aughts as Stockholm's first (and for a long time only) eatery dedicated to Japanese noodle soups. The menu is simple, packed with flavor, and has made the hole in the wall restaurant a Vasastan-classic.

places.name: Racamaca
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Small and cozy Södermalm-restaurant Racamaca quickly garnered attention for its Basque-inspired tapas. Garbanzo, boquerones, and chistorra-sausage turn up in unusual combinations coupled with a great selection of wine and beer.

places.name: Las Brasas
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: The tapas menu on Las Brasas in Vasastan mixes the classically Spanish with typically Nordic ingredients. Manchego, pulpo, and pata negra meet trout, leaks, and cabbage. And if you're still hungry for more the restaurant's barbecue offers a selection of prime cuts.

places.name: Magari Pizza
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Nicolas Cappiello and Giuseppe De Bernardo founded Magari Pizza with the ambition of bringing Stockholm the authentic taste of the Campania region – "where the real Italian pizza was born". Apart from its eponymous specialty, Magari Pizza serves tasty pasta dishes for lunch on weekdays. Gourmet Italophiles will also be

places.name: Capital
places.label: Bar
places.note: The roof bar Capital is located on the 8th floor of the hotel Scandic Contiental. Here you get one of the most beautiful views of Stockholm. Great emphasis is placed on well-designed signature cocktails with a continental touch. The bar menu also includes a wine list, a large selection of beers, and bar food.

places.name: Fjäderholmarnas Krog
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Fjäderholmarnas Krog is located on Stockholms closest archipelago island, Fjäderholmarna. The menu offers both meat and vegetarian options, but primarily lots of fish and seafood. The restaurant is open during the summer season but also serves a popular Christmas buffet in December.

places.name: Möja värdshus & bageri
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Möja värdshus & bageri has been the obvious meeting place on the small island of Möja, since the 1960s. The restaurant is open all year round, serving fresh seafood and restaurant classics, and during the summer season also opens up a small bakery.

places.name: La Barra
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: La Barra wants to take a piece of Spain to Stockholm, or Stockholmers on a trip to Spain if you will. Not only with their tapas dishes which are unmistakenly Spanish, but with a relaxed a lively atmosphere buzzing around the large bar in the middle of the dining room.

places.name: Eden
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Eden is located at the far end of Smedsudden, in a historic 19th-century building formerly known as Annexet. Today, it’s a modern restaurant, bar, and entertainment venue. Now featuring a new food concept, 'Eden Gone Fishing' – a tribute to fish, seafood, and rustic simplicity. Swedish ingredients meet the aromas and f

places.name: Hemma Hos Annika
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: The café, restaurant, and shop Hemma Hos Annika (At Annika's home) is located in Ängby castle that was built in 1692-1696. You can enjoy your coffee or lunch in homey, cozy premises inside or outdoors in a lush park environment. There is also the possibility to book meetings and parties here.

places.name: Texas Longhorn Hammarby Sjöstad
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Texas Longhorn is a Swedish chain of steakhouse restaurants focused on American bbq classics. Burgers, ribs, bangers, and steaks with a side of fries, coleslaw, or mac 'n cheese. There are several locations in Stockholm; Hammarby Sjöstad, Gamla Stan, and Kungsholmen for example.

places.name: Sjöstaden Skybar
places.label: Bar
places.note: At top of Sthlm 101, the tallest building in Hammarby Sjöstad, you'll find Sjöstaden Skybar. Enjoy the view, overlooking Södermalm and Stockholm's southern suburbs, while sipping on a drink or something nice to eat from a menu mixing various restaurant classics. For busy parents, they also offer a nanny service to take

places.name: Capricci
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: An Italian restaurant and bar at Hornstulls strand. Neapolitan pizza, pasta, and other Italian delicacies are served here. Experience dinner in the sparkling new restaurant or enjoy a glass of wine on the outdoor terrace.

places.name: Pong Henriksdal
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Family-friendly Pong is a chain of pan-Asian restaurants that can be found in several locations in Stockholm. The menu is a mix of some of the most beloved dishes of Asian cooking; sushi, dim sum, gyoza, and pad thai.

places.name: Tezukuri Sushi
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Tezukuri is a sushi restaurant, located by the shore of Lake Hammarby in Hammarby Sjöstad. Chose between a selection of maki, sashimi, and moriwase or a warm dish like gyoza, tempura and yakitori.

places.name: Kennys Gelato Sickla
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: In 2022 Kenny Mattsson – founder and namesake of Kennys Gelato – was crowned Swedish ice cream master at the national ice cream championships. The flavors at his parlor vary from timeless classics (vanilla, chocolate, pistachio) to creative combinations (rhubarb and cardamom, lemon, and ginger sherbert).  Currently, Ke

places.name: Stockholm Roast
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Stockholm Roast wants to challenge both the coffee industry and coffee lovers' tastebuds. In practice, this means building personal relationships with sustainable farms all over the world. You can taste the fruits of their labor at their café in Slakhusområdet or buy a bag for home-brewing and you'll also find a select

places.name: Schmaltz
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Swedish cuisine meets European staples at Schmaltz, in a setting and presentation inspired by New York-style deli culture. The menu offers patées, pickles, fish, bagels, and Reuben sandwiches, as well as coffee and classic drinks.

places.name: Hotel Villa Dagmar
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: At Villa Dagmar’s restaurant, Dagmar, the menu is inspired by the Mediterranean, with influences from Southern France and Italy. Here you'll find two of Sweden’s most acclaimed chefs, including Niclas Jönsson, with dishes prepared under the leadership of Head Chef Matias Åslund. The focus is on fresh, seasonal ingredie

places.name: Olli
places.label: Restaurang
places.note: "Kom tidigt och stanna sent" är Ollis motto. Syditalienska rätter och en imponerande vinlista är blott halva upplevelsen; Ägaren Oliver Ingrosso är som bekant artist med band till flera kända svenska musiker, så du kan förvänta dig extra noggranna låtval i den vackra cocktailloungens högtalare.

places.name: Riche Fenix
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Riche Fenix is the newborn sibling of Riche, an over-century-old fixture in the Stockholm nightlife in the swanky Östermalm district. This new venue promises "uncomplicated and thoughtful" food made from the finest ingredients – yet with complex flavours! Located in the middle of the hip Södermalm neighbourhood, the br

places.name: Punjabi Masala
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Punjabi Masal serves Indian cuisine that packs a spicy punch. The unassuming restaurant in the suburb of Tensta has a menu full of beloved flavors like Tikka, Karhai, Vindaloo, and Madras.

places.name: Tekniska restaurant
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Future, innovation and sustainability are the starting points of Tekniska restaurant’s modern food concept. The base is vegetarian dishes, cooked using fresh seasonal products. For those who like fish or meat, it is also available on the menu.

places.name: Pang Pang Festaurang
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Microbrewery Pang Pang, with its innovative and flavorful brews, was one of the first to establish itself during the Swedish beer boom of the 2010s. Besides the brewery and a summer open taproom, Pang Pang runs a restaurant and bar at Hornstull on Södermalm. Here you'll find a selection of beers, ales, and stouts on ta

places.name: Alba
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Cozy wine bar Alba welcomed its first guests in May 2022 and quickly became a hotspot for nature wine aficionados and champagne lovers around Nyttorget. The wine list is updated on a weekly basis and the menu is a rustic mix of french and Italian cuisine.

places.name: Dirty Taco
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Tacos may be a Mexican specialty, but Dirty Taco on Folkungagatan takes culinary cues from the four corners of the world. Here you'll find tacos filled with, for example, Swedish meat, Cypriot halloumi, vegan "kebob" or Vietnamese spices in new and unique combinations.

places.name: Dagges
places.label: Bar
places.address: Hotel Villa Dagmar, Nybrogatan 25-27, Stockholm, Sweden, 114 39
places.note: In the wine bar Dagges you will find the best of Mediterranean wine culture. Take a seat in the bar, in the outdoor area, or on one of the couches and enjoy the music and the great ambiance.

places.name: Vanak
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Restaurant Vanak in Akalla is all about flavorful Persian cuisine. The family restaurant has a wide selection of traditional barbecue dishes, either meat or vegetarian, served with rice or barbari-bread.

places.name: New Mamma Africa
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: New Mamma Africa specializes in East African cuisine from Ethiopia and Eritrea; spicy stew, deep in flavor, scooped up with traditional Injera bread. The restaurant is located near the Kista Galleria shopping mall, in northern Stockholm.

places.name: Lavin
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Lunch and dinner restaurant Lavin serves flavorful and homey Middle Eastern and Kurdish cuisine: kebab, shawarma, Quzy chicken and lamb, Tashrib, fasolja, okra stew, and more. The restaurant is located in Kista, in northern Stockholm.

places.name: Anatolia Kolgrill
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Anatolia specializes in Turkish-style barbecue, cooked over hot charcoal. Get your fill of kebab, iskender, Adana, Mevlana, falafel, or beyti with a generous serving of vegetables and bulgur in this comfort food eatery, located in Husby.

places.name: STHLM Brunch Club
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: STHLM Brunch Club in Vasastan is, obviously, all about breakfast and brunch. They say breakfast is the most important meal of the day, after all. So why not make every meal breakfast? Eggs Benedict, bowls, generous brekkies (breakfast plates), sweet pancakes, freak shakes, and coffee. As of 2023, they also have a locat

places.name: Café Ugo
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Café Ugo on Kungsholmen is an Italian-style espresso bar, serving espresso, macchiato, americano, cappuccino, and Italian snacks and pastries. Stop by for a quick pick-me-up, brewed on imported beans from San Remo, or stay longer and grab a focaccia or panino as well.

places.name: Il Caffé Bergsgatan
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Il Caffé quickly became a favorite coffee haunt for the residents around Nytorget and has since then opened up in several more locations. For example on Drottninggatan in central Stockholm and on Bergsgatan in Kungsholmen. The concept is simple; coffee, Italian-style, with a simple snack like a sandwich or cinnamon bun

places.name: Bröd & Salt Hantverkargatan
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Bröd & Salt is a local chain of artisan bakeries, with locations all over Stockholm. Everything is fresh, made from sourdough, and lactose-free. Besides fresh bread, buns, and cookies Bröd & Salt also has a selection of fresh salads, sandwiches, and wraps if you’re hungry for lunch!

places.name: Komet Café
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Cozy café Komet opened in 2021 and soon became one of the most popular cafées and bakeries on Kungsholmen. You'll find French classics, like croissants and pain au chocolate, Swedish favorites like cinnamon buns and seasonal semlas, coffee from Stockholm Roast, and vegetarian sandwiches for lunch.

places.name: Grain Café
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Porridge is king at Grain Café on Kungsholmen. The café makes its own porridge, all day every day, from local and seasonal ingredients. Grain Café also serves vegan salads, soups, and stews during lunch hours.

places.name: Volca Coffee Roaster
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Volca Coffee Roaster on Kungsholmen is both a café and a specialized boutique by, and for, coffee aficionados. Take a fika break on location or bring one of their specially imported blends home with you. Coffee is carefully selected by forming personal bonds with the farmers themselves. Volca also offers courses and wo

places.name: Konditori Genuin
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Konditori Genuin is a cozy hole-in-the-wall bakery and café on Kungsholmen in Stockholm. Here you'll find freshly baked bread, buns as well as lunch salads and sandwiches. The bakeshop prides itself on a large emphasis on sustainability. For example, it uses green energy to power its ovens, locally sourced ingredients,

places.name: Österlånggatan 17
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Österlånggatan 17 has the atmosphere of a cozy neighborhood restaurant, just a short walk from the Royal Palace in Gamla Stan. The menu offers both small snacks, mid-size dishes, and full meals. Lunch is served every weekday and during weekends you can start your day of Old Town exploration with a hearty brunch.

places.name: Petit Marché
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Petit Marché is Stockholm's probably smallest market where you can buy flowers and plants, or just enjoy a cup of coffee in a nice cozy environment.

places.name: BodyBuddy
places.label: Café
places.note: Delicious food at BodyBuddy is made with nutrient-dense ingredients that sustain health. They also strive to use organic, local, and seasonal ingredients and minimize food waste and plastic use. BodyBuddy is located inside The Yogayama studio at Jungfrugatan 8 and at Smålandsgatan 24.

places.name: Fix
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Café Fix is one of Stockholm's oldest cafés. It was opened in 1910, got popular right from the start and in the 40s it became known as a "celebrity cafe". In 2019, the café was renovated. The premises were modernized but Fix's former glory was preserved by keeping old details. Café Fix offers a large selection of good

places.name: Wilmer Kungsholmen
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Wilmer is a family business that was started on Kungsholmen in 2011 and has since become a popular and well-visited place in the area. Here you can enjoy a cup of freshly brewed coffee, cakes, and buns, have breakfast, lunch, or buy takeaway.

places.name: Poli Caffè
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Poli is a nice little espresso bar with delicious coffee and a genuine Italian atmosphere. Caffe Poli has many loyal customers who come here to enjoy an excellent espresso, a pastry, or a panini.

places.name: By:fiket Stadshagen
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Given that By:fiket stems from the Federation of Swedish Farmers (LRF) their penchant focus on local – often organic – produce, should come as no surprise, nor should its old-timey interiors. The daily specials, posted weekly on Instagram, features culinary fixtures such as Wallenbergare and raggmunk, but also more con

places.name: Pom & Flora Vasastan
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Pom & Flora runs two cozy neighborhood cafés in Stockholm. One in Södermalm and the second in Vasastan. Popular for its breakfast menu, of bowls, porridge, and sandwiches, Pom & Flora is also a good place for a light lunch or afternoon fika.

places.name: Stockholm Brewing
places.label: Bar
places.note: The Stockholm Brewing Co is located inside a former warehouse in Frihamnen, the free port of Stockholm, and here you can try newly-tapped beer the same day it’s released or beers that have been barrel-aged for up to 30 months. There are guided brewery tours and tastings on Saturdays and it's also possible to book priva

places.name: Pepstop
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: At Pepstop, food and drinks are handmade from scratch with extra love and in their purest form – plant-based, organic, gluten-free, unprocessed, and without additives. There is also a Matchabar by Renée Voltaire with hot and cold matcha drinks and other green snacks.

places.name: Café Portiken
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Café Portiken is a small and unasuming café on Kungsholmen. Located in the gatehouse of Serafim Park, Portiken serves sandwiches, fika, and lunch every weekday.

places.name: Dirty Coco
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Dirty Coco is a campy and fun color explosion located on Drottninggatan in central Stockholm. The café's motto is that life is too short to be boring. This translates into a kitschy and colorful café, serving sweet deserts and pastries, copious bowls, crispy lunch sandwiches, juice, and coffee.

places.name: Chez Jolie
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Ingmar Bergmas gata 2 is a renowned gastronomic address, having housed several restaurants and bars. The latest, Chez Jolie, is an entirely french affair. A classic bistro, both cozy and posh, with a menu of beloved french classics and a wine cellar full of delicious wines.

places.name: Zum Franziskaner
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Bierhalle Zum Franziskaner is one of Stockholm's oldest restaurants. Opened in 1889, it's been located at its current Old Town address since 1910. Here you can enjoy a menu of classic Swedish and German comfort food like cabbage rolls, Wienerschnitzel, and black pudding. And, naturally, beer from small and independent

places.name: Lykke
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: At Lykke, the bright ash-tree interiors and hand-picked design chairs hint at the Scandinavian modernity reflected in its menu. The cooks serve Nordic cuisine with a loving twist, flirting with flavors from the Middle East as well as southern Europe. The large community table makes for social brunches and dinners. (And

places.name: Tradition
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: As its name suggests, the popular restaurant Tradition is a place to enjoy beloved Swedish classics. Meatballs, toast Skagen, kroppkakor, apple pie, and more. All made with fresh and uncomplicated ingredients.

places.name: Bord
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Restaurant Bord serves à la carte dinners every day, and four-course Saturday lunches prepared from well-chosen seasonal ingredients. It is a small intimate place with an open kitchen and room for 24 guests.

places.name: Freyja
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Freyja opened in mid-March 2023 and is Stureplangruppens' first restaurant on Södermalm. The new venture is located on Hornsgatan, just a short walk from Slussen, on a spacious rooftop floor. Besides a great panoramic view over Stockholm, Freyja offers a menu of classic Swedish dishes, infused with international flavor

places.name: Café Pascal Östermalm
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Café Pascal has four locations; Odenplan and Gävlegatan in Vasastan, Skånegatan on Södermalm, and Sturegatan in Östermalm. All are defined by their generous sandwiches, a large selection of pastries, and freshly brewed coffee.

places.name: Forma
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Forma opened in 2023, and is a bistro mixing typical French dishes and cookery with Asian flavors and spices. The restaurant, located in Hornstull on Södermalm, also runs a bar open until 03 in the morning.

places.name: Reimersholme Hotell
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Reimersholme is tucked away on the city-close island with the same name, easily reached from Hornstull by foot or bus. Besides being a hotel, Reimersholme has a bar and restaurants and a program of intimate concerts, stand-up comedy nights, improv theatre, and other events.

places.name: Brasserie Balzac
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: A favorite among locals, Brasserie Balzac somehow manages to be both spacious and intimate at the same time. Qualitative ingredients from small suppliers and an authentic lively atmosphere make Balzac a fine dining experience for Francophiles and large groups alike. The eye-catching interior and the remarkably long bar

places.name: Mikkeller Södermalm
places.label: Bar
places.note: Mikkeller is an award-winning craft brewery and chain of bars, founded in Copenhagen in 2006. Besides an exciting selection of ales, IPA, lager, and other beers, Mikkeller has a small selection of  wood-fired pizzas and snacks like a deli platter of cold cuts and Danish smørrebrød sandwiches.

places.name: Grillska Huset
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Everything on Grillska Huset's menu is prepared from scratch using excellent ingredients. It is also a classic Swedish pâtisserie that offers sandwiches, cakes, pastries, pies and tarts. All bread and pastries are from their own bakery. Coffee that is served here comes from the Kersh micro-roastery in Gustavsberg, just

places.name: Fabrique Gamla Stan
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Fabrique is a local chain of traditional wood-fired bakeries that are located throughout central Stockholm. Here you'll find top-quality fresh-baked sourdough bread, rolls, and cakes baked by hand with natural ingredients according to time-honored traditions. In the Old Town, it is located as well at Slussplan 5.

places.name: Solen
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Solen is Michelin-starred duo Adam Dahlberg and Albin Wessman's newest venture. The restaurant is located just outside central Stockholm in Slakthusområdet, the former meatpacking district. The name translates into "The sun" which is reflected on a menu of dishes and flavors from the sunnier parts of the world, like th

places.name: Pava
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Pava looks to the diversity of Californian cuisine for inspiration, with a mix of French, Italian, Pacific, and South American flavors. The art deco-style restaurant is located on Malmskillnadsgatan in central Stockholm, in the new neighborhood of Sergelstadsn.

places.name: Främmat
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Främmat, a small and intimate restaurant in Vasastan, quickly became one of the most talked about restaurants in Stockholm when it opened in 2020. The menu's foundation is classic French cookery, but at the same time constantly experimenting with new dishes and flavors.

places.name: Sthlm City Food Hall
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Sthlm City Food Hall opened in January 2023 and is Stockholm's newest food court. Arguably it's the city's most central as well, with its Sergels Torg location. Here you'll find street food staples as burgers, tacos, ramen and pizza.

places.name: Miyakodori
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: The Izakaya (a type of informal Japanese bar that serves smaller snacks and dishes) Miyakodori opened in late 2022. The menu is a mix of lighter dishes, like salmon sashimi and deep-fried kara-age chicken, small snacks, and deserted. Their speciality though is their selection of barbecued skewers. You'll find both typi

places.name: Bröd & Salt Gamla Stan
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Bröd & Salt is a local chain of artisan bakeries, with locations all over Stockholm. Everything is fresh, made from sourdough, and lactose-free. Besides fresh bread, buns, and cookies Bröd & Salt also has a selection of fresh salads, sandwiches, and wraps if you’re hungry for lunch!

places.name: Café Krans
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Café Krans is located on Västerlånggatan, just a stone's throw from Stortorget and the Royal Palace. The café serves, coffee, tea, pastries, pies, and lighter lunch sandwiches.

places.name: Kaffekoppen
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Kaffekoppen is a classic café in Gamla Stan, having been open on Stortorget since 1994. The café is in a cozy basement, close to the district's most popular attractions, and serves fika, pastries, sweet pies, soup, and lunch sandwiches.

places.name: Restaurang Eld
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Restaurang Eld is a chef-led restaurant by the water on Djurgården. Here Nordic gastronomy, seasonal ingredients and refined craftsmanship meet. The menu is based on game, fish and local products that follow the rhythm of nature. Under the leadership of head chef Irene Frantzen, a personal cooking style is formed with

places.name: Mackverket Vrak Café & Bar
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Mackverket serves hearty sandwiches made from fried sourdough bread, fresh vegetables, and meat from Swedish producers. The restaurant started as a food truck, that still is around, but also operates three permanent restaurants; at STHLM Food Hall, Teatern Food Court on Södermalm, and in VRAK - Museum of Wrecks.

places.name: Pom Friterie
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Pommes frites, chips, french fries, "pompa". At Pom Friterie the beloved side order has been turned into the star attraction. The menu centers around quality fries, topped with various delicacies and flavors from around the world, but also offers snack-sized bites, beer, wine, and cocktails.

places.name: Edsbacka Krog
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Edsbacka Krog is a legendary name in Swedish gastronomy, with 400 years of history. The current restaurant has occupied the same building in northern Stockholm since the 18th century but was founded in 1626, which makes it one of Sweden's oldest restaurants. Located in the lush surroundings of Edsviken in Sollentuna, t

places.name: Stjärtilleriet
places.label: Bar
places.note: Stjärtilleriet descibes itself as "Östermalm's most UNserious coctail bar". But the drinks are seriously inventive, with exciting combinations and presentations. The bar is located in Artilleriet, the museum restaurant at The Army Museum, and also runs a sunny outdoor bar during the summer.

places.name: Asian Post Office
places.label: Bar
places.note: Panasian restaurant Asian Post Office at Regeringsgatan takes its cues from culinary traditions covering all of Asia. Japanese techniques meet Indian spices and Korean ingredients in an exciting fusion. The bar has become as talked about as the menu, with the gin-based Thai Basil becoming the signature cocktail.

places.name: Black Milk Gastro Bar
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Black Milk Gastro Bar is an omakase-style restaurant where guests don't order their food from a menu but enjoy an evening of smaller dishes being served one by one. The cuisine gets its influences from all over the world, with a global mix of techniques and flavours. The main pairing here is not with wine or beer, but

places.name: Bar Oas
places.label: Bar
places.note: Bar Oas is a literal oasis at Drottninggatan, central Stockholm's busiest street. The small homey bar, serves wine, cava, snacks, and light dishes. Perfect for a breather after a hectic day visiting Stockholm, in other words.

places.name: Skeppskattens Hamnkrog
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Skeppskattens Hamnkrog is in Åkersberga, in Stockholm's northern archipelago, beautifully located at the banks of Bammarbo Bay. The menu offers simple and classic pub food, like burgers, char, Wallenbergare, and fish stew.

places.name: Glada Stinsen
places.label: Bar
places.note: Glada Stinsen is a neighborhood pub, with a friendly atmosphere, located at the Södra Station commuter train station. The kitchen serves classic Swedish pub dishes and a selection of Balkan specialties, and Glada Stinsen also has a popular pub quiz every Sunday.

places.name: Söders hjärta
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Söders hjärta is a small and cozy restaurant and bar just off Hornsgatan. Serving both lunch and dinner, the food is a mix of classic dishes and Swedish favorites. Hjärtat, as the locals lovingly refer to it, also hosts regular music quizzes every Tuesday.

places.name: Gastropol
places.label: Restaurant
places.address: Gastropol, Norra Stationsgatan, Stockholm, Sweden, 11364 Stockholm
places.note: In the newly opened Fenix Sthlm conference facility lies Gastropol deli, bistro and rooftop bar, managed by Mattias Berggren – known from Omaka, Eataly and Bianchi. The menu is eclectic, featuring business-lunch classics (steak tartar, oven-baked salmon) as well as more unorthodox elements (katsusando, chirashi sushi).

places.name: Bar Kaja
places.label: Bar
places.note: Bar Kaja is a small cozy bar on Södermalm, serving empanadas and tasty craft beer on tap.  The bar also hosts a popular pub quiz in English, every Thursday.

places.name: Seafood Gastro
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Seafood Gastro opened in the summer of 2023 and is Chef Mathias Dahlgren's latest venture. Located at Grand Hôtel, the exclusive tasting menu sources its flavors and ingredients from the sea: fish, shellfish, algae, water plants, and seabirds. In 2024, the restaurant received its first star in Guide Michelin.

places.name: Svedjan Bageri
places.label: Café
places.note: Svedjan offers its patrons a taste of northern Sweden. Since 2020, the bakery/café offers home-made sandwiches, exquisite pastries, and freshly brewed coffee. All dairy products used are from the eponymous farm, managed by the owners parents.

places.name: Restaurang Leijontornet
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Leijontornet takes wine seriously. Describing itself as "ultra-vinous restaurant and wine bar " with around 3000 bottles in its copious cellar. The restaurant is located in Gamla Stan, in the gastronomic block Leijontornet.

places.name: Kungsholmens Vinbar
places.label: Bar
places.note: Kungsholmens Vinbar opened in 2020, and quickly became one of the district's most beloved hangout spots. The friendly bar naturally has a large selection of wines, but also serves smaller dishes, snacks, and light desserts and sweets.

places.name: Bar Ninja
places.label: Bar
places.note: Bar Ninja is an intimate hole-in-the-wall bar in Södermalm. You'll find a small menu of mid-size dishes, snacks, and, more importantly, lots of delicious wines. Wine importer Niklas Jakobson runs Ninja and focuses especially on natural wines, with a wide selection to choose from.

places.name: Dryck Vinbar
places.label: Bar
places.note: Dryck is a social wine bar at Mariatorget in Stockholm – a vibrant meeting place where a passion for wine and drinks shines through in every glass. It´s focus on carefully selected artisanal wines and small-scale beverages from both Europe and Sweden. Swedish wines, cider, kombucha, and other unique drinks from local a

places.name: Nektar Mat & Vin
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Homey neighborhood wine bar Nektar can be found on Rörstrandsgatan in Vasastan. The menu varies depending on the season, with snacks and mid-size dishes, and the cooler is stocked with tasty natural wines. During the summer Nektar also has an outdoor serving area for anyone wanting a glass of wine or two in the balmy s

places.name: Gaia Matbar
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Lively neighborhood restaurant Gaia quickly made a name for itself in Midsommarkransen, with its playful menu of inventive mid-size dishes. The restaurant in Southern Stockholm also has a good eye for natural wines, offering different bottles every week.

places.name: Grus Grus
places.label: Bar
places.note: Grus Grus is restaurant Tranan's sister bar and focuses on craft wines and food that follow the seasons. Here you can drink wines on obscure grapes from unknown areas or order in a really classic bottle. The menu includes snacks, cheese, cold cuts, smaller and bigger dishes to share, all matched with wines selected by

places.name: Kasten Bistro & Vinbar
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Since Kasten takes its name from a legendary sommelier, restaurant-goers come with high expectations. The Vinstocken wine bar offers natural wines and other hip drinks, while the more classic wines are served in the restaurant section. The menu consists of mid-sized servings with extra attention paid to the (seasonal)

places.name: Bistro Leoparden & Snabba Katten Bakficka
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: In dreamy, peach-pink premises on Tegnérgatan, Bistro Leoparden is managed by experienced restaurateur siblings Markéta and Jakub Vávra. Here, italophiles can enjoy delicacies such as Tuscan mortadella, Italian oysters, and ricotta cake. However, bistro rests firmly on two foundations: firstly, the artisanal pizza (bak

places.name: Meetballs & Pancakes
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Meetballs & Pancakes is a newly opened restaurant on Södermalm that offers classic, homemade meatballs with mashed potatoes, lingonberry jam, and cucumber salad. Here, everything is cooked from scratch and there are vegetarian and vegan meatballs available. There are also classic and American pancakes on the menu.

places.name: Bambi
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Laidback French bistro and wine bar Bambi opened its doors in the fall of 2023. The menu is unpretentious, but with great ambitions, and constantly changing from week to week. Lively, welcoming, and with a wine list that leans heavily on natural wines.

places.name: Källarbyn
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: In spite of its prime location in the tourist-dense Old Town, Källarbyn has earned a reputation among its many regulars for being not only cozy and authentic, but even and good value. The atmospheric 18th-century cellar with its eclectic decoration attracts mixed crowds. The frequent live concerts, extensive wine (– an

places.name: Älskade Traditioner
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Retro-café Älskade Traditioner mixes the typically Swedish with international evergreens (how about a cinnamon bun freakshake?). But the highlight of the menu is the waffles, both sweet and savory (called "wraffles").

places.name: Internationella Pressklubben
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Intertntionella Pressklubben om Vasagatan serves a seasonal menu of classic pub and Central European dishes. But Pressklubben's main event is its beer menu. The restaurant has one of Stockholm's largest selections of Belgian beer—the bar stocks around 800 kinds of Lambic, Blonde, Pils, and Trappist from 150 breweries.

places.name: Akkurat
places.label: Bar
places.note: Akkurat is a well-known name among beer aficionados, not only in Sweden but internationally as well. The bar on Hornsgatan pops up regularly on lists and rankings of the world's best beer bars. Akkurat has a rotating selection of 28 brews on tap and a large cellar of vintage beer, with over 500 bottles of aged beer.

places.name: 3Sixty Skybar
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: As the name suggests, 3Sixty Skybar offers a stunning panoramic view over Stockholm from its location close to Liljeholmen. The interior is inspired by 1920s elegance, with the round bar serving refreshing cocktails.

places.name: Rosetta's
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: The relaxed feel of Rosetta's is akin to that of a retro dive bar in Los Angeles (or a Swedish summer cottage, depending on whom you ask). In the hip Hornstull area, the restaurant has become appreciated not only thanks to the atmosphere, but from the successful marriage between comfort-foods and plant/seafood ingredie

places.name: Crêperie Fyra Knop
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Fyra Knop, open in the cozy neighborhood of Södermalm in 1993, was the first French crêperie in Stockholm and probably in Sweden. Besides the great variety of galettes and crêpes with different fillings, you‘ll find organic wine and farmhouse cider here. The ambiance, accompanied by eclectic music and paintings on the

places.name: Restaurant Reisen
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: The hotel business at the historic Hotel Reisen dates back to 1819. The restaurant’s menu blends international dishes and brasserie classics with a modern twist, all with a spectacular view of Skeppsbron.

places.name: Café Roddarhuset
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Since 2007, Café Roddarhuset, located in an old boathouse in Vaxholm, has offered a blend of art and culinary delights. Guests are treated to the day's lunch, fresh salads, pies, sourdough sandwiches, coffee, tea, cold beverages, homemade pastries, and ice cream. Visitors can enjoy arts and crafts from all over the cou

places.name: Solbrännan Restaurant & Café
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Nestled in the Stockholm archipelago, Österskärs Havsbad offers a serene oasis for anyone seeking a delightful dining experience. Solbrännan is more than just a place to eat; it's a gathering spot for friends and family to enjoy delicious meals with breathtaking views. Whether you prefer dining indoors or outside on th

places.name: Bullandö Krog
places.label: Restaurant
places.address: Bullandö krog, Bullandö Marina Krog, Värmdö, Sweden, 139 56 Värmdö
places.note: Bullandö Krog is a restaurant located on the beautiful coastline of Värmdö. It's a place where gastronomy meets the charm of the archipelago. The restaurant offers a generous terrace and panoramic windows, providing an outstanding archipelago view. Live music is available during the summer to make the evening more memo

places.name: Restaurant Motorverkstan
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: For those seeking a relaxed atmosphere and a taste of archipelago life, Motorverkstan Djurö is the perfect choice. The archipelago restaurant, outdoor bar, and a varied à la carte menu attract land and sea travelers. Enjoy good food and drink in a unique environment by the sea.

places.name: Värmdö Musteri
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Värmdö Musteri uses local ingredients to produce high-quality musts, juices, jellies, and other delicious products. Visitors can sample these tasty treats and participate in the must-making process. Additionally, the café serves a variety of traditional Danish open-faced sandwiches (known as smørrebrød) and delectable

places.name: Hamnkrogen
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: A beloved restaurant in Vaxholm since 1958, welcoming visitors for lunch, dinner, or drinks while overlooking the harbor. The restaurant serves, among other things, the popular Waxholm herring.

places.name: Bar Montan
places.label: Restaurant
