places.address: Bar Montan, Förbindelsehallen, Johanneshov, Sweden,  Johanneshov
places.note: The humble thrift-store decors of Bar Montan, coupled with its rough industrial surroundings, might lower your expectations. places.name: Triton
places.label: Restaurant
places.address: Restaurang Triton, Ringvägen, Stockholm, Sweden,  Stockholm
places.note: Triton is run by nerdy food lovers who want you to feel right at home. The laid-back premises on Ringvägen mirror the ambitions, with guests being offered a full view into the open kitchen. A dinner package consists of an entrée and two main courses, with wine package or dessert to be ordered on the sida. For its reaso

places.name: Petri
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Petri is an elegant restaurant with a down-to-earth approach. The restaurant's credo is evident both in its name – "petri" being shorthand for petrichor; the scent of rain falling on dry soil – and menu. Petri works closely with local producers and farmers for a menu that mixes simple ingredients with elaborate cooking

places.name: Ramen Manga
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Lunch restaurant Ramen Manga serves brothy ramen soups with chicken, pork, or veggie options in mild or spicy combinations. Located on Pilgatan, directly adjacent to Hantverkargatan, it's a great place for a quick lunch in the middle of Kungsholmen.

places.name: Francis & Francis
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Francis & Francis have served inventive blends of soft-serve ice cream with anything-goes toppings, on severeal different Stockholm locations, since 2017.

places.name: Café Klotet
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Café Klotet, restaurant Gondolens sibling, is a relaxed bar and restaurant with a simple and playful menu. Klotet is located on the floor above Gondolen, in Katarinahuset, overlooking Slussen. The name is borrowed from an older restaurant  located on the building's ground floor between 1877-1935.

places.name: Skog
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Sundbybergs Kafé och Gelateria, or Skog for short, is an artisan ice cream parlor in the northern Stockholm suburb of Sundbyberg. The café serves chilled deserts all year round with both evergreen flavours and unique creations.

places.name: Monrads
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Deli -and restaurant Monrads in Djursholm have served fresh seafood since 2007. In April 2024 Monrads branched out with a second location in central Stockholm, but the idea is the same. Relax and have a lovely fish, lobster, or shellfish in the dining room, or buy delicacies over the deli counter to bring back home.

places.name: Pelago
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Summer rooftop restaurant Pelago is one of the new additions to the family of restaurants in Katarinahuset, Slussen. The large outdoor bar and restaurant is open during the summer and offers a great view of central Stockholm. The food is primarily bbq-dishes from the Middle East and Argentina, complimented by canned co

places.name: Parken
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Despite its name, Parken is located indoors, near Ellen Keys on Östermalm. Founded by influencer Penny Parnevik and Swedisch Master Chef-winner Christin Kashous, Parken's menu offers a mix Mediterranean and Middle Eastern cuisine.

places.name: NOFO Wine bar
places.label: Bar
places.note: NOFO Wine bar is located at the eponymous hotel in Södermalm. The mood is relaxed and informal, with a wine list that aims to surprise. During summer the bar opens up its cozy courtyard area.

places.name: NÒR Södermalm
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: NÒR Södermalm is the restaurant and bar at the Clarion Hotell on Ringvägen. The establishment has long been popular for casual after-work hangouts and drinks and has hosted the LGBTQi-club "Hotellhänget" since 2013. The menu mixes flavors from Sweden and Southern Europe. The drink list is a blend of the bar's signature

places.name: Allegrine
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Allegrine is chef Daniel Couet's hommage to his grandmother's classically French cooking, with typical French herbs, spices, and seasonal ingredients. But what was rustic and simple, has been reinterpreted in a modern take. Across the street, you'll also find the restaurant's wine bar Bar Etablé.

places.name: Créme
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Ice cream café Créme opened in May 2024 on Brännkyrkagatan on Södermalm. Specializing in creamy soft-serve cones and cups, the frozen deserts are in various flavors and with crunchy and sweet toppings.

places.name: Dashi
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Dashi is named after the eponymous Japanese broth; a cornerstone in Japanese gastronomy used in soups, sauces, marinades, and much more. places.name: Ruben
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Ruben's menu describes itself as a global fusion. With influences from the Nordics, Italy, Asia and Africa, Ruben aims to take their guests into a flavourful trip around the world - all while feeling right at home in the neighborhood restaurant located in the heart of Norrmalm. With spontainety being the overall theme

places.name: BAP - Burgers & Pastrami
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: BAP's menu combines two kinds of sandwiches; juicy burgers (meat or vegan options available) and spicy Italian pastrami. The restaurant on Östermalm has been hailed as one of the best burger joints in Sweden and also serves shakes, drinks and the customary burger sides like fries and onion rings.

places.name: Bonden & Burgaren
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Bonden & Burgaren ("The farmer & the burger") might be Stockholm's most local burger. The restaurant is run by Väddö dairy farm in the northern Stockholm Archipelago, with meat and cheese sourced from its cows.

places.name: Animo
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Animo is a modern neighborhood restaurant. Their á la carte menu follows the seasons, feeling and creativity. There is also an innovative cocktail bar with a lively wine list of handpicked favorites.

places.name: Acaza
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: When Acaza opened in the summer of 2023 it was the first of its kind in Stockholm; a cozy neighborhood pub all about Portuguese cuisine. Traditional classics like bacalhau, bitoque, and caldo verde are served in a relaxed and homey atmosphere.

places.name: LOKAL Koppartråden
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: LOCAL Koppartråden is a new restaurant in the historic factory building from the end of the 19th century in central Sundbyberg. Here the focus is on local, seasonal ingredients and the menu includes some classics prepared in a modern way.

places.name: Lu
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: When Lu opened in Malmö, in 2019, it quickly became one of the city's most talked about eateries. When the family-owned restaurant branched out to Stockholm in the summer of 2024 diners were more than ready for its spicy Cantonese specialties. The menu takes its cues from the gastronomic melting pot that is Hong Kong –

places.name: Botica
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Botica is a Portuguese restaurant in the heart of Stockholm. There is an open kitchen bar where guests can sit and interact with chefs preparing dishes on a charcoal grill. You can also savor wines at their cozy wine bar next door to the main restaurant.

places.name: Skörden
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Skörden is a new neighborhood restaurant on Södermalm. The menu is varied and offers a wide range of dishes at different prices and flavors from the world's different cuisines. Skörden also houses the trainee program Chefs Camp, which will shape future chefs.

places.name: Moe's Burger
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Moe's Burger in the suburb of Kista serves high-quality burgers and is among the best burger places in Sweden according to Burgerdudes, one of the world’s leading websites for hamburger reviews!

places.name: Bistro Zissou
places.label: Restaurant
places.address: Bistro Zissou, Lilla Nygatan, Stockholm, Sweden,  Stockholm
places.note: A cute, French-ish family bistro, where Kalle Lindborg (of Kagges and Sillkaféet fame) have set out a romantic, southern European course with his partner and sommelier Emma Skerfe. places.name: ergo.
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Ergo is an informal fine-dining restaurant with high ambitions, with a staff is hand-picked from top restaurants in Stockholm (and throughout the world) by head chef Petter Johansson, himself a veteran of numerous Michelin-star establishments.At Ergo, seasonal ingredients are prepared using French methods. The result i

places.name: MXCO
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: MXCO is a tortilleria, taqueria and cocktail bar. MXCO puts a great emphasis on using the best ingredients to create authentic Mexican food. Tortillas here are always made directly to order and the lime is pressed for each Margarita. The interior of the venue is inspired by a classic taqueria in Mexico City.

places.name: Café Cuvée
places.label: Bar
places.note: Café Cuvée is a charming and relaxed bistro-style restaurant in central Södermalm. Though the menu is international, it leans heavily on French and Swedish cuisine, and the wine list consists mostly of French wines.

places.name: Rara
places.label: Restaurant
places.address: Rara restaurant, Torsgatan, Stockholm, Sweden,  Stockholm
places.note: Himalayan cuisine is not well-known in Sweden, to say the least. At Rara, visitors get a rare opportuniy to sample Nepalese dishes, such as Momo dumplings in savory broth, Hakka noodles with chicken, and much more – all made on-site from scratch. Vegetarian options abound, and the playful coctail menu is definitely wor

places.name: Brännerian
places.label: Bar
places.note: Brännerian is the small bar belonging to local distillery Stockholms Bränneri. Armed with unmatched expertise, the classic cocktail ingredients are modified (or swapped completely), to create new variations based on new ideas and local ingredients. Their aim is to produce all the spirits they serve in the bar on site!

places.name: Bar Brahe
places.label: Bar
places.note: Jazz -and cocktail bar Brahe is Hotel Reisen's cozy backdoor hang-out spot. The bar has a separate entrance and offers great ambiance, refreshing drinks, and live music.

places.name: Mama Wolf
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Mama Wolf on Södermalm serves Japanese street food and everyday day-dishes. For example, onigiri (fuffed rice balls), don (rice bowls with various toppings), and thick udon noodles. places.name: Birka Bowling & Dart
places.label: Bar
places.note: Birka Bowling has kept balls rolling (against pins) since the 1970s. The bowling alley is one of central Stockholm's largest with 17 lanes for classic bowling, disco bowling, and VIP bowling. You'll also find a dart arena, karaoke rooms, and a sports bar serving beer and burgers.

places.name: Svarta Hästen
places.label: Bar
places.note: Nothing is black and white at Svarta Hästen, even as the establishment has become a watering hole for Stockholm's chess aficionados. The wine bar is warm and cozy and even offers chess tutoring for anyone who wants to hone their skills.

places.name: Kanon
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Barbecue restaurant Kanon opened its doors in October 2024. The cozy restaurant is on Tjärhovsgatan, a short walk from Slussen or Medborgarplatsen. places.name: The Flying Horse
places.label: Bar
places.note: The Flying Horse has been a meeting place for Vasastan's sports fans since 2010. The pub, located near Odenplan, screens SHL, Premier League, Champions League, La Liga and much more. places.name: Bistro Bestick Gamla Stan
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: After having been a mainstay on Bryggargatan for 10 years, family-owned Bistro Bestick opened a second location in early 2025. The restaurant, founded by Stadshuskälaren's former head chef Björn Fischer, serves a mix of sophisticated French cuisine and beloved Swedish classics.

places.name: ok ok
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Laidback neighborhood restaurant ok ok served its first meal in 2023, just a short walk from Tessinparken on Östermalm. The menu treats diners to a seasonal offering of midsize dishes, a relaxed ambiance, and a handpicked selection of ciders from small and independent producers.

places.name: Florentine
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Florentine is inspired by the Italian 1970s, something that is evident when looking at the theatrical interior. The restaurant offers dishes from all over Italy and craft cocktails at the bar. Imagine an Italian family dinner where everyone shares Italian classics with a modern twist.

places.name: Basta
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: On the fourth floor of Åhléns City, there is a restaurant inspired by the sunsets of Capri. On warmer days, you can dine outside on the rooftop terrace. The menu is based on Italian classics with a twist, and the restaurant remains open even after the store has closed.

places.name: Kafé Plattan
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.address: Kafé Plattan, Sergels Torg, Stockholm, Sweden,  Stockholm
places.note: In the lowest level of the iconic Kulturhuset, in the very heart of Stockholm, lies Kafé Plattan. The atmosphere is casual and friendly, and all fika and light meals served are 100% vegan. Everything on the menu is made in-house, from artisanal sourdough bread and kimchi to modern, plant-based meat dishes.

places.name: Kersh
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: At Kersh, they serve their own coffee alongside fika and traditional Swedish snacks. The café, located in a former tobacco shop, has quickly become a popular gathering spot in Södermalm. In addition to the food and drinks, visitors appreciate the music and the welcoming atmosphere.

places.name: Holidays American Bar and Restaurant
places.label: Bar
places.note: Even though it might not look like anything special, Holidays has a lot to offer. They serve beer at a reasonable price, and the kitchen prepares American classics. On the TVs, they show various sports, and the outdoor seating on Götgatan is perfect for guests who want to experience the pulse of the city.

places.name: The Sparrow
places.label: Bar
places.note: A mix between a bar and a restaurant, where you can enjoy French influences from breakfast through to the evening. The focus is on creating an inviting after-work hangout, where champagne and wine are paired with small delicacies. places.name: Panza
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: At Panza, they serve Italian classics like lasagna, risotto, and pinsa to suit all tastes. With a strong passion for Italian food culture, the restaurant aims to offer a genuine experience through well-prepared dishes. They also provide babysitting for parents who want to enjoy a child-free meal.

places.name: Glenn Miller Café
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: The archetype of what a jazz club should be. Here, you sit close to the band and can enjoy both the food and the music. Glenn Miller Café has made a name for itself among jazz fans, and the club takes great pride in the artists who have played here over the years. places.name: Framfickan
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: The theatre Maxim has its own restaurant, designed to extend your cultural experience. Here, you can enjoy Asian small plates with Scandinavian inspiration—or simply have a drink at the bar. Friendly dogs are welcome, as long as the restaurant isn’t too crowded.

places.name: Ponti
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: At this restaurant, Italy and California meet—with a twist. After working at some of Stockholm’s most well-known restaurants, three chefs joined forces to create a dining experience inspired by the dishes that have shaped them. Ponti also has a bar that, in a short time, has become popular among the locals.

places.name: Funky Chicken Food Truck
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: The food truck that changed the hamburger scene in Stockholm. places.name: Le Pop
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: At Le Pop, in Ringen Centrum, Södermalm, you'll find handcrafted ice cream on a stick. Choose between different dips and toppings based on what you like!

places.name: Bullandö Glassfabrik
places.label: Café
places.note: At Bullandö Glassfabrik in the Stockholm archipelago, fresh gelato has been made daily for the past 14 years. The ice cream factory is strongly influenced by Sicilian traditions, inspired by the founders’ many trips to the town of Stintino. The factory at Bullandö is open on weekends.

places.name: Persona
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: The team behind Persona hails from the acclaimed Frantzén, and their culinary roots are evident in every dish, combining high ambition with a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere. places.name: Bacchi Syre
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: At Järntorget in Stockholm’s Gamla Stan (Old Town), you'll find Bacchi Syre – a green meeting place spread over three floors, featuring restaurants, bars, and a café. In addition to plant-based food and drinks, the space includes discussion stages, workspaces, event areas, and an art gallery.

places.name: Gelato Crema
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Gelato Crema, part of Café Crema, offers authentic Italian gelato. Every day you’ll find 12 different gelato and sorbet flavors made from scratch. Gelato Crema is located at Hornsbergs strand and Kungsholms strand.

places.name: Stockholm 1897
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: The team behind Sandhäxan and Frippe are now opening Stockholm 1897 by the Djurgårdsbron bridge. This year-round bakery, café, and restaurant offers Swedish flavors for every occasion. They’re also opening a sauna down by the water, complete with a beer tap and the opportunity to take a dip in the canal.

places.name: Gamla stan 1859
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Gamla stan 1859 is located in the heart of Stockholm’s Old Town. The premises date back to the 1600s and offer creamy, locally produced gelato made from carefully selected ingredients. In addition to gelato, they also serve coffee, an exclusive selection of teas, and confectionery.

places.name: Lundbergs Konditori
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Lundbergs Konditori opened in Gröndal (Tvärbana Line 30) in 1946 and has preserved the same interior atmosphere ever since. places.name: Gelateria Amore
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Gelateria Amore on Långholmsgatan 5 in Stockholm is the perfect spot for anyone in search of gelato. In addition to traditional gelato, they also offer vegan options. You’ll also find handmade cakes, gelato cakes, homemade chocolate, pralines, and desserts.

places.name: Sjöstaden Gelato
places.label: Café
places.note: In Hammarby Sjöstad, you'll find freshly made Italian artisan gelato, served daily since 2021. Their Italian gelato is crafted using Swedish milk, a splash of cream, fruit purées, nuts, and chocolate sourced from around the world

places.name: RiRi
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Located by Hornstulls strand, the restaurant RiRi is connected to the cinema Bio Rio. At the heart of the kitchen stands a large grill where fresh ingredients are cooked over an open flame. The cuisine is inspired by the Mediterranean, with a strong focus on seasonal flavors. RiRi offers drop-in seating at the bar.

places.name: Stockholm Stadshotell
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: At Stockholm Stadshotell, food and drink take center stage, with two restaurants offering Nordic flavors and global influences. places.name: Ärla
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Restaurant Ärla is housed in a former pizzeria, parts of which remain intact. places.name: Season Hotel
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Season Hotel is set to open in May 2025 in Jungfrusund, Ekerö. This family-owned hotel will feature a spa, a restaurant, and its own brewery. places.name: Ring Katarina
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: As the name suggests, Ring Katarina is located at the corner of Ringvägen and Katarina Bangata.A small wine and food bar with 25 indoor seats and a summer outdoor patio. Serving exciting natural wines and small dishes with European influences, the menu is updated regularly.

places.name: Bastardo
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: The corner of Surbrunnsgatan and Birger Jarlsgatan has a proud restaurant tradition dating back to the 18th century. places.name: Bacchanale
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: At Ringvägen 110 you’ll find Bacchanale, a restaurant run by the same team behind Främmat in Vasastan. The menu features flavours mainly from Southern European cuisines, using local ingredients. Most of the cooking is done in the large wood-fired oven. places.name: Celeste
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: A young and ambitious restaurant in an interesting location. Celeste is the sister restaurant to Etoile, and here you can choose between a tasting menu in the dining room or drinks on the rooftop terrace—or why not a combination of both? Head Chef Jonas Lagerström is a well-known Swedish chef who has won the TV competi

places.name: Beck Kaffebar
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Close to Medborgarplatsen, you’ll find Beck Kaffebar. In addition to organic coffee, they offer a selection of sandwiches, freshly baked treats, and salads. There are also great options for vegans, vegetarians, and those who are gluten intolerant.

places.name: Baggio Kaffebar
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Baggio is a small Italian coffee bar in Sibirien that draws espresso enthusiasts from near and far. They serve a carefully curated coffee menu, classic pastries, breakfast sandwiches, and lunch pizza. The atmosphere is warm and familiar – just like at the espresso bars in Italy.

places.name: Café Skeppsholmen
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Café Skeppsholmen offers views of both the Old Town and the Royal Palace. The café is part of the hostel and is open year-round. It serves simple hot dishes, pastries, and drinks. During the summer, there’s also outdoor seating available.

places.name: Muttley & Jack’s
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: On Södermalm, you’ll find Muttley & Jack’s, a coffee bar offering a wide selection of coffees and beans. Their coffee is roasted at their own roastery out on Vaxholm. In addition to classic pastries, they serve breakfast and lunch, and on weekends, brunch is also available.

places.name: Pom & Flora Rörstrandsgatan
places.label: Coffee Shop / Café
places.note: Pom & Flora runs several cozy neighborhood cafés in Stockholm. One in Södermalm and two in Vasastan. Popular for its breakfast menu, of bowls, porridge, and sandwiches, Pom & Flora is also a good place for a light lunch or afternoon fika.

places.name: Bistro Mirabelle
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: In the restaurant-dense Sibirien district, you’ll find the French Bistro Mirabelle. The menu offers simple, rustic dishes without any fuss. There are 30 seats, an open kitchen, emerald-green wainscoting, plain wooden tables, and a chalkboard menu. Every Sunday, a three-course set menu is served.

places.name: Bar Abrovinsch
places.label: Restaurant

places.note: Guldbaren, (The Gold bar) på femstjärniga Nobis Hotel är lika elegant som den låter. Väggar och tak täcks av guldspeglar och här blandas cocktails i mästarklass. Häng i baren eller slå dig ner på en soffa i den vackra ljusgården intill.

places.name: Sjöfartshotellets Takterass
places.label: Bar
places.note: Här är baren där du kan beställa en drink med tillhörande utsikt. Terrassen på Scandic Sjöfartshotellets takterass bjuder på en avslappnad miljö med Stockholms hamninlopp som sällskap. Den är en ganska liten men exotisk oas, inspirerad av Karibien och dekorerad med palmer och färgade lyktor.

places.name: Restaurang Indio
places.label: Restaurang
places.note: Indio är Sveriges första Nikkei-restaurang; den unika mattradition som uppstod när japanska jordbrukare emigrerade tvärs över Stilla Havet till Peru i slutet av 1800-talet. Menyn bjuder bland annat på unik sushi och sashimi samt ceviche och tiradito gjord på Nikkei-sätt.

places.name: Kappa Bar
places.label: Bar
places.note: E-sport baren Kappa visar regelbundet matcher och mästerskap i bland annat CS:GO, Dota2 och League of Legends på storbildskärm. För dig som hellre spelar än tittar på, finns det både speldatorer och VIP-hörna utrustad med sköna multiplayer-spel. Dessutom anordnar Kappa regelbundna quiz om spel, film och serier.

places.name: Rivals Bistro och Bistrobar
places.label: Restaurang
places.note: På Rivals Bistro används de bästa från säsongens ingredienser. De omtyckta klassikerna är självklart på plats samt en ”Plat du jour” som komplement till ordinarie menyn.

places.name: Björk Bar & Grill
places.label: Restaurang
places.note: Soth's Kitchen hittar du på Courtyard by Marriott på Kungsholmen i Stockholm. I egenskap av heldagsrestaurang välkomnas gäster både för frukost, lunch eller en avkopplande middag på kvällen. Menyn är rotad i det svenska köket, med amerikanska influenser.

places.name: Röda Villan
places.label: Restaurang
places.note: Röda Villan bjuder på god mat grillad över öppen eld, boule och vacker utsikt över Stockholms inlopp. Restaurangen ligger på Fjäderholmarna, Stockholms närmaste skärgårdsö, och håller öppet under sommarsäsongen om vädret tillåter.

places.name: Boule & Berså
places.label: Restaurang
places.note: Sommaröppna Boule & Berså ligger vacker beläget vid vattnet under Danviksbron i Nacka. Här kan du, om vädret tillåter, spela boule äta något enkelt och gott eller ta ett glass vin eller öl i baren.

places.name: Schmaltz Bar & Delicatessen
places.label: Restaurang
places.note: På Schmaltz möts det Svenska och Europeiska köket för att tillagas och presenteras på ett sätt som påminner om delikulturen i New York. Inläggningar, fisk, patéer, bagels och klassiska Reubenmackor finns på menyn, tillsammans med både drinkar, vin och kaffe.

places.name: Tekniskas restaurang
places.label: Restaurang
places.note: I Tekniskas restaurang står hållbarhet, innovation och framtid i fokus. I köket pågår ständiga experiment med nya metoder för att ta vara på hela grönsaken. Det som inte går att ta hand om blir till näring för nya grönsaker i museets egna odlingar.

places.name: Alba Vinbar
places.label: Restaurant
places.note: Avslappnade vinbaren Alba öppnade i maj 2022, och blev raskt ett populärt vattenhål för naturvinsentusiaster och bubbelälskare. Vinlistan väljs med omsorg, med nya tillskott och gästspel varje vecka, och den fransk-italienska menyn är rustik och enkel – men smakrik!

places.name: Solbrännan Restaurang & Café
places.label: Restaurang
places.note: Upptäck en oas vid Österskärs havsbad i Stockholms skärgård. Solbrännan är mer än bara en restaurang; det är en plats där vänner och familj samlas för att njuta av en måltid med oslagbar utsikt. places.name: Restaurang Motorverkstan
places.label: Restaurang
places.note: För den som söker en avslappnad atmosfär och en smak av skärgårdslivet är Motorverkstan Djurö det perfekta valet. Skärgårdsbistro, egna bryggor, utebar och en varierad à la carte-meny lockar både land- och sjöfarare. Njut av god mat och dryck i en unik miljö vid havet.

places.name: Pascal Cafe & Roastery
places.label: Café
places.note: I Café Pascals första kafferosteri på Gävlegatan kan besökare njuta av en nyrostad kopp kaffe, och samtidigt få en direkt inblick i processen. Lokalen har en modern, industriell känsla med maskinerna i fokus. Här fortsätter familjen bakom kaféerna att utveckla sitt hantverk med etiskt producerade bönor och småskalighet

places.name: Sessanta – Italiensk vin & matbar
places.label: Restaurang
places.note: Sessanta är en italiensk vinbar och restaurang på Karlavägen i centrala Stockholm, där italienska smaker kombineras med en lätt skandinavisk touch i en avslappnad och livlig miljö. Menyn erbjuder italienskinspirerade smårätter, stenugnsbakad surdegspizza och hemlagad pasta, gärna att dela tillsammans med vin från olika
